Therefore, this paper proposes a novel method for gear pitting fault diagnosis based on Fiber Bragg grating strain sensors to process the strain measurements. The algorithm employs a normalization and cross-correlation process to filter out the disturbance caused by load or speed fluctuations whilst improving the effectiveness of the fault detection based on strain measurements.

articleTitle: A SysML Description for TT&C System
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: A general description modeling method of Space tracking, telemetry and command (TT&C) system based on system modeling language (SysML) is provided for reliability evaluation. By using SysML diagrams, this paper this paper gives the requirements modeling and behaviors description method. A modeling process for a TT&C mission of satellite launch is illustrated as an example. It shows that SysML model can provide a clear description of TT&C system for reliability modeling.

articleTitle: Research on maintenance decision of rail transit signal power supply system
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The fixed period maintenance strategy is generally adopted in the rail transit signal power supply system. This maintenance strategy inevitably leads to the over repair or insufficient maintenance of each power supply module in the power supply system. This reduce the reliability of the power supply system itself, and affect the normal operation of other equipment. In order to make the maintenance strategy more consistent with the degradation rule of signal power supply system, and improve the reliability of equipment and save the maintenance cost. This paper used the Monte Carlo simulation to obtain the reliability of each power supply module in the signal power supply system. Based on the reliability models of power supply modules, the two-dimensional optimization objective of average reliability and maintenance cost of signal power supply system was established. The availability was established and used as constraint condition, particle swarm optimization algorithm was used to optimize the model, and the optimal detection period and maintenance mode were obtained. The result shows that the maintenance methods of the four power supply modules in the rail transit signal power supply system are basically the same during the first to the third maintenance. During the 4th to 8th maintenance, the maintenance methods of the four power supply modules have shown different forms.

Author Keywords: rail transit signal power supply system

articleTitle: Gearbox Fault Diagnosis using Novel Dilated CNN and Piecewise Loss Function under Unbalanced Data
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Planetary gearbox, as key components of rotating machinery, constantly works under harsh environment, which would cause various fault modes. Accurate and intelligent gearbox fault diagnosis methods help to improve the maintenance economy and reduce reliance on research experience. Convolutional neural network (CNN) has been fully applied in rotating equipment fault diagnosis due to the advantages of weight sharing and supervised learning ability. However, most researches focus on the balanced samples, and it is expensive to collect enough fault samples in practical situation. In order to improve the diagnostic performance under unbalanced samples, a new method based on CNN and piecewise cross entropy (PCE) is proposed. Firstly, a novel multi-scale dilated CNN (NMDCNN) is constructed using zigzag dilated convolution to enrich the coverage of the fields of view and avoid the loss of information. Secondly, PCE is utilized to balance the misclassification cost between health samples and fault samples. The experiment of planetary gearbox data proves the superiority and validity of proposed method.

articleTitle: Condition Monitoring of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor under Different Stator Fault Severity
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Stator fault accounts for almost 40% in motor faults, and inter-turn short fault is regarded as the primary cause for the fault. To detect the inter-turn insulation fault, this paper uses the three-phase current unbalance degree as the fault indicator to monitor motor condition in real-time. Firstly, the fault characteristic is calculated, and then the implementation of the fault diagnosis algorithm is introduced through a step-by-step procedure. Furthermore, experimental results from a 400W permanent magnet synchronous motor are shown before and after the stator inter-turn fault occurs. Moreover, the fault characteristic at various stator fault severities under different number of shorting turns and connection resistances are demonstrated, which indicates that the current unbalance is an importance parameter to realize the stator fault online monitoring and diagnosis.

articleTitle: Sensor Fault Mode and Effect Analysis in Nuclear Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper introduces sensor fault mechanism in nuclear power plants, provides the statistics of sensor faults in a number of in-service plants, summarizes the fault modes, causes and effects of typical sensors, and studies the methods of defining and quantifying sensor faults. It provides reference information for sensor condition online monitoring and signal reconstruction algorithms, such as the selection of reconstruction signal and monitoring frequency.

articleTitle: Evaluation model of practical effect of Ideological and political education based on deep data mining
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The current evaluation model of practical effect of Ideological and political education results in serious distortion due to the poor data processing ability. In view of this problem, the paper constructs the evaluation model of the practical effect of Ideological and political education based on deep data mining. The cluster method in data mining is used to clean and preprocess the practical effect of Ideological and political education. Select the correlation function to construct the index system of the practical effect evaluation of Ideological and political education. According to the data and index system, the paper uses analytic hierarchy process to construct the evaluation model of practical effect of Ideological and political education. So far, the design of the practical effect evaluation model of ideological and political education based on in-depth data mining has been completed. The construction of the experimental link to test the use of this model, the experimental results confirmed that the data processing capability of this model is significantly better than the current model. This model can be used in future research to complete the evaluation process.

articleTitle: Research on Multiple Cross Correlation Fusion Method of Fault Vibration Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Auto-correlation and cross-correlation methods are combined with other signal processing methods, which are widely used in identifying fault sources and extracting fault features, but the extracted fault features are not obvious enough. Compared with the auto-correlation and cross-correlation methods in signal processing, this paper proposes a vibration signal multi-cross correlation fusion algorithm. This method associates the information obtained by the three vibration sensors to obtain a correlation coefficient. The Fourier transform simulation is used to compare and analyze the correlation coefficients of the pairwise cross-correlation and the direct multi-cross correlation of the fault simulation signal, highlighting the superiority of the direct multi-cross correlation method to obtain the signal three-correlation coefficient. Finally, the stacked auto encoder (SAE) diagnosis method is used to compare the fault diagnosis classification results of the original fault data and the multi-cross correlated fusion data in the test.

articleTitle: Design of PHM Test Verification Method and System for Aviation Electrical System
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Modern aircrafts are developing from the traditional energy architecture to the multi-electric and all electric architecture. The extensive use of electrical equipment puts forward higher requirements for safety, reliability, and maintainability. The PHM (Prognostics Health Management) technology is an advanced technology to improve the maintenance level of aviation electrical equipment. However, the PHM technology developed for aviation electrical systems has difficulties in verifying its effectiveness. This paper completed the requirement analysis of PHM test verification of aviation electrical system, and compared the characteristics of several verification methods. It summarizes several different experimental verification methods. It studied the PHM test verification method flow of aviation electrical system, and designed a PHM test verification system for aviation electrical system.

articleTitle: An Improved Marginal Index Method to Diagnose Poor Welded Joints of Heavy-haul Railway
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Vertical acceleration of the axle box can usually reflect the high-frequency impulse of poor rail welded joints. To effectively diagnose poor welded joints of Heavy-haul railway, we propose a new method by combining wavelet packet decomposition (WPD) with adaptive synchro-squeezed short time Fourier transform (ASSTFT). Firstly, we decompose axle box acceleration of Heavy-haul railway by WPD and obtain a series of sub-signals. ASSTFT is utilized for each sub-signal and all of the time-frequency distributions are added together to obtain the overall time-frequency distribution of axle box acceleration. Next, we calculate the moving effective marginal spectrum of filtered time-frequency distribution. Finally, the marginal index of welded joint (WJMI) is obtained by normalizing moving effective marginal spectrum, and then we can give a threshold at 10 by statistical analysis of cumulative distribution. WJMI method is able to effectively detect and locate poor rail welded joints, and the filtering range of poor welded joints for heavy-haul railway is from 300Hz to 800 Hz. The proposed approach is proved to be valid and stable enough to diagnose poor welded joints.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamics Characteristics of Labyrinth-seal-rotor System with Pedestal Looseness
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: A non-linear dynamic model of a grate-tooth sealed rotor system with a loose support fault is established. The finite element method is used to simulate the rotor system with loosening fault, and the fault characteristics of the rotor system are obtained. Simulate loosening fault experiments, and verify the correctness of the simulation results through experiments. The research results show that when the system has no sealing force, a frequency division component with lower amplitude appears in the subcritical speed zone. In the super first-order critical speed zone, the frequency characteristic of the rotor system is mainly divided by frequency, and there is a period of 2 movement. The interval appears, the lower part of the axis trajectory of the loose end is suppressed, and “clipping” appears in the lower part of the time domain waveform graph. When the system has a sealing force, the frequency division caused by the loosening fault disappears, the amplitude of the high frequency component increases, and the rotation speed of the air flow excitation frequency is delayed. The research results provide a theoretical reference for the diagnosis of the loosening fault of the rotor system.

articleTitle: Train Axle Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on Tunable Q-factor Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Train axle bearings are one kind of key components in train vehicles and works under poor conditions which easily results in failure. Vibration signals generated by train bearings include rich information of its operating conditions. Signal processing plays an important part in discussing the vibration-based condition monitoring (CM) technique. In this paper, an efficient method Tunable Q-factor wavelet transform(TQWT) is proposed. Simulation and laboratory experiments are conducted to test the proposed method. Experimental results are verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Thermal Design and Thermal Reliability Analysis of SAR Antenna System Unfolding
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The SAR antenna system is a core component of the Qilu-1 microsatellite payload. The successful unfolding of the feed source and reflecting surface is the basic prerequisite for the normal operation of the payload. The temperature of the joints connected with them as the primary unfolding criterion are directly related to the success or failure of the antenna system. Therefore, thermal design and thermal reliability analysis are needed. In this paper, the thermal control of the feed source joint is designed and the circuit reliability is analyzed. The key parameters that affect the temperature of the reflecting surface joint are considered and the predicted temperature is simulated. The predicted temperature uncertainty of the reflecting surface joint is calculated, the optimal unfolding stage and thermal reliability are analyzed. The unfolding process of the antenna system is designed and the response times are tested or simulated. Finally, the antenna system unfolded successfully as expected in the orbit. This paper can be used as a reference for the thermal design and reliability analysis of other small SAR antenna systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Evaluation Indicators’ System for Health Management Effectiveness of Communication Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of the factors influencing the health management of communication equipment, this paper briefly analyzes the specific content of its effectiveness evaluation and the principle of constructing the indicators’ system, establishes the indicators’ system of health management effectiveness evaluation of communication equipment using Delphi-method, k-means cluster discrete theory and rough intensive method to screen the indicators, and elaborates the connotation of each indicator item.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of English Listening Distance Teaching Based on ID3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In the evaluation of English listening distance teaching effect, the traditional evaluation method has serious disturbance under the pressure of data, and its ability of resisting pressure needs to be improved. Aiming at this problem, this paper puts forward an evaluation method of English listening distance teaching based on ID3 algorithm. According to the different stages of distance teaching of English listening, the evaluation index system of teaching effect is constructed, and the consistency ratio is calculated. When the consistency condition is met, the ID3 algorithm is used to calculate the information entropy of the evaluation index, construct the decision tree, determine the evaluation rules, and obtain the comprehensive evaluation result of teaching effect through multi-layer compound calculation. Experimental results show that the proposed evaluation method based on ID3 algorithm can improve the ability of resisting pressure under the pressure of data, and the disturbance rate is small.

articleTitle: Evaluation of vibration induced local fatigue in aluminum alloy structure by using laser ultrasonic technique
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Vibration induced fatigue is one of the main forms of structural failure. Especially, the failure mode of aircraft and mechanical structures, which are in complex vibration environment for a long time, usually belongs to vibration fatigue. However, due to the limitations of existing measurement technology, the generation and development process of vibration fatigue damage is still uncertain. A guided wave based method is proposed that a laser ultrasonic system is set up to scan the 2024-O aluminum alloy intermittently in the vibration fatigue process. The propagation characteristics of wave in the specimen are collected, so that the fatigue degree of local area can be characterized based on the change of wave velocity. This experimental method can track the development of fatigue damage, record the process of fatigue accumulation, and further realize the stiffness calculation of the most serious fatigue area.

articleTitle: Real-time Prediction Model for Satellite Telemetry Parameter Based on PSRT-RVM
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: A large number of nonstationary, nonlinear and periodic telemetry data have been collected to support the prognostics and health management of satellite which are not suitable for traditional time series prediction models. This paper proposes a PSRT-RVM model based on the joint optimization of quantum genetic algorithm (QGA) for on-orbit prediction. The method first separates the trend terms based on the time series decomposition theory to stabilize the remaining terms. The PSRT-RVM model optimized by QGA is used to predict the residual term while the trend term is fitted with a polynomial. Finally, the two predicted values were recombined to get the predicted results. The feasibility and effectiveness of this method are verified by the comparative experiment of the periodic telemetry parameters of a satellite in China.

articleTitle: Unified FFL model based reliability, safety and testability integrated analysis method
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: With the widely and deeply application of intelligent Integrated Logistics Support, PHM and other technologies in the field of aviation equipment, the importance of reliability, safety and testability (RST) has become increasingly prominent. This paper proposed the RST integrated analysis method based on the functional fault logic(FFL) model in MBSE. This paper first analyzes the main work content and general idea of RST. The RST work focus on “functional architecture fault logic “of the products, and the common functional fault logic model for RST is established, it realizes model reuse in RST analysis process. Then the modeling language, tools steps in the modeling process are discussed. Based on the functional model, the fault logic relationship could be reflected, and it is more closer to the real situation of the fault, more effectively solves the “two skin” problem in reliability engineering. Based on the common model, by collecting and analyzing the information of the special part of the Reliability, Safety and Testability, RST model could be supplemented and improved, the RST metrics could be evaluated respectively. Finally, a case study of the fuel system with frequent failures is carried out, and the advantages are analyzed.

articleTitle: Estimation of Remaining Useful Life of Li-Ion Battery Based on Charging Characteristic Data
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Nowadays Li-Ion battery, as a typical secondary energy storage device, is widely used in various applications due to its property of high energy storage density. However, its capacity gradually reduces as repeated using of discharging and charging, which presents battery characteristics of degradation. The research utilizes battery charging and discharging experimental data published by the NASA Ames to the estimate remaining useful life (RUL) of a Li-Ion battery. The relation of the capacity and the charging voltage as well as current of the battery is found firstly. And then, by employing Particle Filter (PF) algorithm, degradation process and battery RUL are estimated based on probability distribution. The results show that the proposed method can effectively estimate RUL of Li-Ion battery.

articleTitle: Analysis of unbalance sensitive position of flexible slender shaft rotor
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In this paper, the dynamic model of a slender shaft flexible rotor is established by using the finite element method. The first two natural frequencies and mode shapes of the system are solved by using the characteristic equation, and the unbalanced vibration response of the flexible rotor system is calculated by using the Newmark numerical integration method. The sub critical, critical and supercritical states of the rotor are analyzed respectively. The sensitivity of the axial position of the slender shaft to the unbalance mass is analyzed through simulation calculation.

articleTitle: A multi-synchrosqueezing ridge extraction transform for the analysis of non-stationary multi-component signals
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Condition monitoring (CM) signals of rotating machines operating under varying speed condition typically exhibit amplitude modulation and frequency modulation characteristics. A recent study [G. Yu, T. R. Lin. Mech. Syst. Signal Process. 147 (2020) 107069] shows that multi-synchrosqueezing transform (MSST) can effectively extract the distinctive time frequency features from non-stationary signals using an iteration process in conjunction with the synchrosqueezing transform. However, the noise contained in a signal can become a serious problem as the number of iterations increases in the transform. An alternative time-frequency analysis (TFA) method blending a ridge extraction technique and a MSST transform is thus proposed in this study to overcome the noise interference problem. In this approach, the ridge extraction technique is used to extract each mono component contained in the TFA results of the MSST in turn. A noise-free time frequency representation can then be reconstructed by superimposing the time frequency distributions of all mono-components for an accurate fault diagnosis of rotating machines under varying speed condition. A peak-hold-down-sample (PHDS) algorithm is also utilized in this work to improve the computation efficiency and to avoid possible computer jamming caused by large data. electronic document is a “live” template.

articleTitle: On-line crack propagation prognostics using a resample-move particle filter
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Accurate prognosis of crack propagation is of great importance for prognostics and health management (PHM) to improve the safety of aircraft structure and reduce the operation and maintenance cost. Nonetheless, fatigue crack propagation is a complicated random process influenced by several uncertainties such as intrinsic material properties, loading conditions and environment. The particle filter (PF) based method is suitable for nonlinear and non-Gaussian problems, so as to be one of the most advanced and powerful methods to solve crack propagation prognostic problems. Under the PF framework, the crack measurements are fused to estimate model parameters and the current crack state, so as to achieve on-line prognostics of the future moment. However, the basic PF usually suffers from particle diversity impoverishment, which reduces the prognostics performance. To solve this problem, an on-line crack propagation prognostics based resample-move particle filter is proposed in this paper, which increase the particle diversity by a moving step of crack propagation model parameters after resampling. The proposed method is verified on the fatigue test of aircraft attachment lugs.

articleTitle: State Evaluation of Long-term Storage Product Based on Cloud Model and TFN-AHP
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: State is an important characteristic of a product. The strategy of condition based maintenance mainly depends on accurate evaluation of state. Long-term storage products, such as missiles, are usually tested with less number of times. That results in few information for constructing a state evaluation model. State of a product is the comprehensive reflection of multi-components status level. In this paper, the triangular fuzzy number (TFN) was utilized in analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to overcome the defects of subjective fuzziness in weight distribution. And the cloud model was introduced to describe qualitative information for state evaluation. A numerical example with a product in storage is introduced to illustrate engineering applicability of the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerant Control of Actuator in Intake Pressure Regulation System Based on Walcott-Zak Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Intake pressure regulation system is an important facility to simulate the intake pressure environment at different heights, and its regulation quality directly determines the accuracy and reliability of environment simulation system. When the intake pressure regulation system operates continuously for a long time, the working environment is very bad, and the actuator of the intake pressure regulation system is usually directly exposed to high temperature and strong vibration, the actuator may fail. Aiming at the important role of actuator in the work of intake pressure regulation system, the fault types of actuator in intake pressure regulation system are analyzed, and an actuator fault-tolerant control system based on Walcott Zak sliding mode observer is designed, which makes full use of the strong robustness and anti-interference ability of sliding mode. In order to overcome the problem of high-frequency chattering, quasi sliding mode is used to replace discontinuous switching term. Then, the fault reconstruction effects under bias fault and drift fault are simulated. The simulation results show that this method can effectively eliminate the influence of actuator fault on the closed-loop control system of intake pressure regulation system.

articleTitle: Visual Integration of Mental Health Information of College Students Based on Fuzzy-Grey
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: College Students' mental health information resources involve a wide range and a large amount of information, resulting in the time-consuming and laborious query of information and low operation efficiency of the existing information resource integration platform. In order to solve the above problems, a visual integration method of College Students' mental health information based on Fuzzy Grey is designed. The visual integration design of mental health information is carried out based on nonlinear mapping algorithm and off-line chaotic model mapping algorithm, which realizes the collection, screening and integration of information resources. Experiments show that the mental health information resource integration platform based on Fuzzy Grey technology has excellent performance

articleTitle: A Dynamic Modeling and Simulation Method of Built-in Test(BIT) Based on State-chart Diagram
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: At present, the domestic test modeling and simulation work is mainly based on the multi-signal model. This method is not intuitive enough and lacks applications that can dynamically display the fault transfer relationship of the BIT system, the BIT operation logic, and the fault detection and isolation demonstration. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a BIT modeling and simulation method based on state-chart diagram, and develops related modeling software. First, the basic principles and simulation ideas of state-chart diagram are introduced. Then, the BIT modeling architecture based on the state-chart diagram is introduced, and the realization of the state-chart diagram of the static structure elements and the realization of the state-chart diagram of the dynamic process elements are explained in detail. Finally, a case verification was carried out. By using the self-developed BIT dynamic modeling and simulation software, the product model, fault model and BIT model of the case were constructed, and the predicted results of testability indicators were given, which proved the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Based on Agent Simulation of System Components
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The characteristics of complex systems such as randomness, and time-varying parameters make it difficult for traditional reliability analysis methods to meet the reliability requirements of complex systems. As a key link of fault prediction and health management technology, fault diagnosis plays a significant role in equipment support. This paper studies the problem of fault diagnosis, uses Agent-based simulation methods to simulate system components, builds a fault propagation model, locates high-risk sources, and traces high-frequency faulty components from system faults. And take the fault diagnosis of the ship's lubricating oil system as an example to carry out simulation experiments to verify the feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: The Effects of Constructing National Innovative Cities on Foreign Direct Investment
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: National innovative city pilot project plays a vital role in improving the level of national independent innovation and also in concentrating on higher quality economic growth. Based on the panel data of 213 cities in China from 2003 to 2018, the paper uses difference-in-difference (DID) method to empirically examine the effect of constructing national innovative cities on foreign direct investment (FDI). Results show that the national innovation city pilot policy generally shrinks the scale of FDI, and has a greater effect on prefecture-level cities when municipalities directly under the central government, provincial capitals and sub-provincial cities are removed from the samples. These findings highlight the significance of improving independent innovation and attracting high-quality FDI.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Mistuned Preload in Rod Fastened Rotor in Gas Turbine Based on CWT
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Rod fastened rotor is widely used in heavy duty gas turbine, its dynamic behavior directly effects the security and efficiency of the gas turbine set. The preload detuning is one of the common faults of the rod fastened rotor, it will increase the vibration and threaten the stable operation of the system. In this paper, the effect of preload force on interface between disks is simplified to the bending stiffness of interface by sub-model stiffness method, which is verified by modal test. Secondly, the finite element model of rod fastened rotor is established, the correctness of this model is proved by comparing the calculated and experimental orbits results. Finally, the transient response during the relaxation is simulated by finite element model, and the common time-frequency domain signals are obtained by continuous wavelet transform (CWT). This research contents and methods can provide ideas and references for rod fastened rotor preload mistuned fault analysis.

articleTitle: Settlement Prediction Method of Bridge Pile Foundation on Soft Soil Foundation Based on Hyperbolic Method
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In order to improve the fitting degree between the predicted value and the measured value of pile foundation settlement of bridge on soft soil foundation, a method of pile foundation settlement prediction of bridge on soft soil foundation based on hyperbola method is proposed. According to the deformation mechanism of soft soil foundation, the deformation process of soft soil foundation is analyzed from three stages: plastic elastic deformation, uneven deformation and creep; According to the settlement deformation of soft soil foundation, the settlement development process of soft soil foundation under the action of bridge pile is studied from three stages of instantaneous settlement, primary consolidation settlement and secondary consolidation settlement, and the final settlement of foundation is calculated; In terms of time, the soft soil foundation is divided into two parts: construction period settlement and post construction settlement, and the development time of foundation settlement is calculated; The settlement of bridge pile foundation on soft soil foundation is predicted by hyperbolic prediction equation and hyperbolic fitting method. Experimental results: the fitting degree of the settlement time curve between the predicted settlement value and the measured settlement value of the bridge pile foundation is very high, and the error is mostly within 1%, the maximum is not more than 3%, which has high applicability and reliability.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Diagnosis Operation and Maintenance System for Circulating Water Pump
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Circulating water pump is the key equipment in nuclear power plan. In order to improve the safety and reliability of circulating water pump, an intelligent diagnosis operation and maintenance system is designed in this paper. The core decision points of this system are online monitoring and status assessment, diagnosis of typical fault modes, health prediction, maintenance decision and optimization. The fault operation data are obtained by building a circulating pump test bench, then transfer to the real circulating pump. Finally, the optimization decision of the maintenance program is given. Intelligent diagnostic operation and maintenance system enables the circulating water pump to change from regular maintenance and preventive maintenance to state maintenance, reducing maintenance frequency and cost.

Author Keywords: intelligent diagnosis operation and maintenance system

articleTitle: Design of Economic Management Course Network Construction System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In order to improve the teaching efficiency of economic management courses, this paper designs a networked construction system of economic management courses based on big data technology. This paper introduces the design and development of a new class appointment system based on big data technology, and designs the hardware of the system with the help of J2EE framework. In the part of system software, the distance teaching module is designed, and big data technology is used to optimize the learning steps. Experiments show that the maximum CPU ratio of the system designed in this paper is below 65%, and the system security reliability is high. It realizes the optimization of network course of economic management.

articleTitle: The Fault Re-decision Method based on the Different Decreasing Functions
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The fault diagnosis method (FDM) is widely used in machine operation and maintenance. However, the wrong decision made by the FDM might cause the machine unnecessarily to shut down. To reduce the number of false alarms, this paper proposes a fault re-decision method based on the key-delay technology. The original data from sensors are inputted into the inner fault diagnosis method (IFDM) and the proposed method only employs the results from the IFDM as the input. Then according to the improved key-delay technology and comprehensive consideration of current result and previous results, the re-decision is given. To illustrate the proposed method, a case study on gear is presented in this paper, which shows that the proposed method does decrease the false negative rate.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis and simulation for under water engineering robot
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In order to improve the safety and accuracy of underwater engineering robot, the dynamic modeling and simulation analysis of the robot body and driving device under the action of water flow are carried out. Firstly, the three-dimensional model of horizontal thruster, vertical propeller and ROV(Remotely Operated Vehicle) body is established, and then the hydrodynamics and static structure analysis are carried out. Then, the results of hydrodynamics and static structure are introduced into modal module, and the first ten modes of thruster and robot body under the condition of current are analyzed, and the parameters of vibration frequency, amplitude and deformation displacement are obtained under different order. The simulation results verify the safety of the robot under the action of water flow and provide guidance for the design of the robot structure parameters.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Analysis of Highway Tunnel Excavation Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In the numerical simulation of highway tunnel excavation, it is difficult to calculate the yield criterion of rock and soil in traditional calculation, which leads to the lack of individual parameters in the final numerical simulation results, resulting in the low overall stability of tunnel deep foundation section, rebound rate of deep foundation pit bottom and limit equilibrium rate of supporting pile. Therefore, a numerical simulation analysis method of highway tunnel excavation based on artificial intelligence algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the damage stage method is used to confirm the surrounding rock pressure parameters. After confirming the stability of the surrounding rock, the seismic factors of the highway tunnel are considered to determine the buried depth of the tunnel. The yield function is used to calculate the yield criterion of geotechnical materials. Finally, the artificial intelligence algorithm is used for numerical simulation. The simulation results show that the overall stability of the tunnel deep foundation section, the rebound rate of the deep foundation pit bottom and the limit equilibrium rate of the supporting pile are high.

articleTitle: Design of Diagnostic Reasoning Software for Fluid System
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Fluid system is an important part of fluid machinery, and its health affects product performance and operator safety. In order to ensure the working performance of the fluid system, based on the fluid system testability model and logic diagnosis, the fluid system diagnostic reasoning software is designed. First, establish a fluid system testability model to obtain system D matrix information; then, based on the obtained D matrix, create a D matrix knowledge base to form a set of diagnostic algorithms; finally, a software for state detection and fault reasoning for fluid systems is developed. The results show that this method can effectively perform state detection and diagnostic reasoning on fluid systems.

articleTitle: Research on single image super resolution enhancement algorithm based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: To solve the problem of low edge protection index in traditional enhancement algorithm, a single image super-resolution enhancement algorithm based on deep learning is proposed. The super-resolution feature of a single image is extracted by the sinusoidal two-dimensional transform function modulated by Gaussian function. The local Laplacian filter is used to preprocess the super-resolution of a single image, and the deep learning method is introduced to enhance the super-resolution of a single image. The experimental results show that the improved method has higher edge protection index, can effectively improve the enhancement accuracy, and has certain advantages.

articleTitle: Reliability Modeling of Two-unit System with Degradation Interdependence
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The interdependence of the degradation process is widespread in multi-unit systems. Effective analysis of the interdependence in the degradation process is essential to model the reliability of multi-unit systems. This study establishes a unilateral dependence and interdependence degradation processes model based on the Wiener process, and analyzes the reliability and failure intensity of the two-unit parallel and series system. The influence of the interdependence on the reliability and failure intensity of the two-unit system is obtained using a numerical model.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction using Dynamic Principal Component Analysis and Deep Gated Recurrent Unit Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Massive multi-sensor data makes it challenging to extract degradation features and predict the remaining useful life (RUL). This paper introduces a novel RUL prediction method using dynamic principal component analysis (DPCA) and deep gated recurrent unit (DGRU) network. DPCA is utilized to construct the health index (HI) curve considering autocorrelation. DGRU network is built to predict the RUL based on the constructed HI curves. The dataset of turbofan engines is used to verify the proposed method. The results show that the proposed RUL framework creates a higher accuracy than other related work.

articleTitle: Construction of Indoor Environment Spatial Layout Planning Model Based on 3D Virtual Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In view of the low accuracy of spatial quantitative layout in the existing layout planning model, the planning attribute nodes of the spatial layout planning model deviate from the standard attribute points, and the planning effect of the planning model is poor. To solve this problem, the indoor environment spatial layout planning model based on 3D virtual simulation technology is constructed. The 3D virtual simulation technology is used to mark the space planning points, and the genetic algorithm is used to solve the multi-level layout of indoor space features, control the layout accuracy, quantify the spatial structure of indoor environment, and set the layout accuracy parameters to complete the construction of the layout planning model. After setting the simulation scene, the simulation scene layout planning points are calibrated, and the planning model based on the spatial geometric characteristics, the planning model based on the network element layout optimization algorithm and the designed planning model are selected for testing. The results show that the designed planning model divides the attribute nodes evenly around the standard attribute points, and the planning effect is the best.

articleTitle: A Universal High Performance Intelligent Processor Of Satellite
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: With the development and maturity of artificial intelligence technology, more and more space remote sensing satellites begin to use artificial intelligence technology to solve the problem of remote sensing image real-time processing. Payload image processing of remote sensing satellite is a complex system, involving process control, data acquisition, data transmission, data storage, analysis and processing. At present, the image processing process of most remote sensing satellites is roughly the same, but the requirements for image processing are different, resulting in different image processing algorithms, and then the hardware computing power requirements are different. This paper presents a design of universal high-performance space-borne intelligent processor, which has the characteristics of high performance, high reliability and redundancy, supports configurable computing power, and has strong versatility.

articleTitle: A Semi-Markov Maintenance Model for Bridges Synthesizing with Four Types of Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Bridges are one of the most critical infrastructures, and their maintenance management has aroused widespread concern due to the high expenditure and serious consequences after the failure. Most of the current studies on bridge maintenance only explored limited uncertainties, which can hardly match the real dynamic situation. Hence, we formulate a semi-Markov maintenance model for bridges synthesizing with four types of uncertainties. The uncertainties include the uncertainty of the state, the uncertainty of the deterioration rate, the uncertainty of the maintenance effect, and the uncertainty of the inspection interval. These types of uncertainties are all common in actual bridge maintenance. They have effects on the maintenance decision and increase the difficulties of bridge maintenance. Our approach considers these uncertainties and enables a more realistic model for bridge deterioration and maintenance. In the numerical example, we explore the impact of the uncertainty of inspection interval on the optimal policy. The results demonstrate that a large inspection interval may lead to the conservative optimal policy. This approach can be extended to other similar scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Civil Aircraft Maintenance Man-Hour Evaluation Method Based on Maintenance Sequence
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: As domestically produced civil aircraft are put into operation, the importance of aircraft maintainability level becomes prominent. The quality of its design directly affects operating costs and further affects the aircraft’s market competitiveness. However, there is a lack of quantitative analysis data and appropriate method support on the maintainability design of civil aircraft in China. This paper draws on the experience of senior airline maintenance experts and maintainability design engineers, through in-depth analysis of civil aircraft maintenance procedures and collecting a large amount of Maintenance Man-Hour (MMH) data, establishes a maintenance action library based on maintenance sequence, refines the degree of difficulty of maintenance actions, determines and revises the basic standard MMH On this basis, the MMH model, the maintainability optimization design method and the MMH management database were further established. This research provides a powerful method and tool for the maintainability evaluation of civil aircraft in China.

articleTitle: Research on Operating Nurse Assignment Based on Fatigue Quantification
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In order to balance the workload of the operating nurses on an operating day, this paper first decomposes the operations of the operating nurses and employs the JACK software to simulate the working posture. The REBA scores are obtained according to the body radian of working posture, and the RMR values are obtained from REBA scores. According to the basic body data of the operating nurse and the continuous working time, the fatigue load of the nurse is quantified. Based on the quantification of nurse fatigue, this paper constructs an operating nurse scheduling model and uses lingo software to solve it. Finally, the effectiveness of the model is verified through a case study from M Hospital in Sichuan Province. The quantification of the fatigue-based nurse arrangement model can not only ensure the hospital’s surgical care needs, but also balance the burden of operating nurses, improve the health of nurses, and provide a reference for the humanized work arrangements in the hospital’s daily medical services.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of New English Talents Training Model Based on AHP-Entropy Method
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The current talent training model evaluation model uses the AHP method to calculate the evaluation index weights, which leads to the calculation of the evaluation index weights of the new English talent training model, which is difficult to pass the consistency test. To solve this problem, a new type of English talent training based on the AHP-entropy weight method is proposed. Model evaluation model. Based on the five principles of evaluation indicators, the evaluation indicators of the new English talent training model are divided into four levels: target level, criterion level, first-level index factor level and second-level index factor level, and establish an evaluation index system; The evaluation index system is divided into five levels and assigned to determine the set of evaluation system comments; The change of evaluation index is controlled between 0 and 1, and it is divided into positive index and negative index; Entropy weight method and AHP method are used to calculate the weight of evaluation index respectively. According to the calculation results, the weight of comprehensive evaluation index is obtained, and the final evaluation result is obtained through multi-level and step-by-step evaluation. The experimental results show that: the calculated evaluation index weight, the consistency test result is less than 0.1, and the consistency test is passed.

articleTitle: Performance reliability evaluation of explosive initiator based on Bayes-Bootstrap method
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: As the first component of weapon, ammunition, aerospace and other systems, improving the accuracy of performance reliability evaluation of small sample explosive initiator is very important for its reliability evaluation and life evaluation. In order to improve the performance reliability evaluation accuracy of explosive initiators with small samples, this paper proposes a performance reliability evaluation method based on Bayes-Bootstrap method. The proposed method increases the sample size by simulation sampling, and reduces the repetition rate of sampling data by randomly weighting the simulating samples, and improves the accuracy of parameter estimation, and finally improves the accuracy of the performance reliability evaluation of explosive initiators with small samples. Finally, Mont-Carlo simulation and case analysis are carried out, and the results show that the proposed method is superior to the commonly used methods for performance reliability evaluation in engineering when the sample size is less than 20, and the proposed method can achieve better accuracy.

articleTitle: Fault Simulation and Experimental Verification of Axial Piston Pump Based on AMEsim
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of complicated faults and few fault samples of the axial piston pump, firstly, a simulation model of the axial piston pump was established based on AMEsim. By changing the relevant parameters of the simulation model, three types of faults are simulated: abrasive wear of the rotor-piston friction pair, abrasive wear of the rotor-oil separator friction pair, and slipper edge collapse, and the law of the oil volume changing with the failure is analyzed. Then, an axial piston pump fault injection test system was built to test two types of faults: abrasive wear of the rotor-piston friction pair and sliding shoe collapse. The results show that the test results are similar to the simulation results, and the combined analysis can provide a reference for the tracing of the failure mechanism of the piston pump.

articleTitle: Adaptive Noise Reduction Method of Sensor Signal for Health Monitoring of Civil Engineering Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: At present, the adaptive noise reduction method of sensor signal can not accurately reduce the noise points, and the ability to identify the change of azimuth of sensor signal is poor, resulting in poor noise reduction ability. In order to solve the above problems, a new adaptive noise reduction method for the health monitoring of civil engineering structure is studied. The mathematical model is established, the expression of noise function is analyzed, the noise function is determined, the software model is used for simulation design, the noise coefficient is extracted, the coupling system is established, the sketch map of the edges of different noisy signals is determined, the absolute coordinates of sensor signals are determined in the coordinate system, and the adaptive noise reduction of sensor signals is carried out according to image threshold and communication mode. The experimental results show that the adaptive denoising method for the health monitoring of civil engineering structure can reduce the noise point by half, and improve the ability to understand the change of the sensor signal azimuth.

articleTitle: A FE-DE-FV Parallel Computing Method Based on OpenMP for the Hydraulic Fracturing
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: With the continuous increase of global energy demand, unconventional oil and gas resources such as shale and tight reservoirs have occupied an important position in the global energy structure. Large-scale hydraulic fracturing is the main method used to extract shale and tight reservoirs. However, because hydraulic fracturing is affected by complex in-situ stress and reservoir heterogeneity, the generation and propagation of hydraulic fractures are complicated. In this paper, a finite element-discrete element-finite volume (FE-DE-FV) parallel computing method based on Open Multi-Processing (OpenMP) is proposed to accurately and efficiently simulate hydraulic fracturing. This parallel computing method can be effectively applied in practical engineering. The high efficiency of parallel computation is verified and numerical simulations under different in-situ stress conditions are analyzed in this paper. The results show that the FE-DE-FV parallel computing method can accurately and efficiently simulate hydraulic fracturing.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis and Belief Reliability Evaluation of Electromagnetic Performance of Electronic Products
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper proposes a simulation analysis method of anti-electromagnetic interference based on field-circuit co-simulation for a case. Without considering the degradation of electronic products, the interdisciplinary equation, margin equation and measurement equation are established based on the margin reliability principle and the uncertainty principle, which are used to conduct a belief reliability assessment of anti- electromagnetic interference before products are put into use. Based on the evaluation results, optimization and improvement measures are proposed to improve products’ reliability. The application of belief reliability theory and method in electromagnetic simulation analysis is realized, and it is of great significance to the improvement of existing electromagnetic simulation analysis methods. Finally, the paper summarizes the full text and looks forward to the follow-up work.

articleTitle: The Factors Affecting the Quality of Teaching on the Internet Background
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: With the development of Internet, mobile Internet, artificial intelligence, and other information technology, “Internet + education” is profoundly affecting the reform and connotation of higher education, information-based teaching is bound to become the general direction of China’s teaching reform. Universities are important bases for training talents, and the key to improving the quality of education is to improve the quality of teaching. The rapid development of modern information technology has had a profound impact on the curriculum reform of universities. In this paper, in order to further improve the quality of mixed online teaching mode as the goal, to select part of the teachers and students in colleges and universities as the research object, the key links in implementing mixture with online teaching mode in-depth research and analysis on the teaching pattern of the popularity and identity, found that the factors influencing the quality of online teaching, puts forward the effective method to improve the teaching quality of online mixing. At the same time, the research data were analyzed and summarized, and the main problems and Suggestions were put forward, hoping to play a positive role in promoting the reform of online education and teaching under the background of the Internet.

articleTitle: Deformation monitoring method of connection structure of prefabricated building based on RBF network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In the deformation monitoring of the connecting structure of prefabricated buildings, the traditional monitoring method is difficult to guarantee the data quality when the monitoring distance is far or there are many obstacles. For this reason, this research designed a method for monitoring the deformation of the connection structure of a prefabricated building based on RBF network. First, use RFID positioning technology to determine the location of the connection structure of the prefabricated building, and then use the inclination sensor and STC15F2K60S2 microprocessor to collect deformation data. Based on this, set the RBF network parameters, input the collected deformation data into the RBF network, and use LoRa technology to design a remote monitoring communication module. With the support of this module, the deformation data is transmitted to the monitoring center, and the deformation degree of the connecting structure is judged through calculation and analysis of the monitoring results. The experimental results show that the effective communication transmission distance of this method is relatively long, and its monitoring signal quality is high, and the monitoring accuracy is high.

articleTitle: Plunger pump cavitation fault recognition based on analysis of low frequency energy
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The cavitation problem is a typical failure of plunger pumps, and it is difficult to be accurately identified due to the unobvious characteristics of the failure. To solve the above problems, firstly, the mechanism of cavitation failure is analyzed, and the influence of cavitation phenomenon on outlet pressure pulsation is obtained; then, in order to identify the outlet pressure characteristics, a cavitation failure identification method of plunger pump based on low-frequency energy analysis is introduced. Then, the high-speed plunger pump cavitation test is carried out under different cavitation degrees, and the pressure pulsation signal at the outlet of the plunger pump is collected. Finally, the energy integral sum and the relative energy integral sum in the specific side frequency interval of each harmonic component of the low frequency band are calculated, and the calculation result is used as a new characteristic quantity to characterize the different cavitation states of the plunger pump. The results show that the edge frequency energy integral sum has a high degree of discrimination for the cavitation state, which is suitable for the identification of the cavitation state.

articleTitle: A Cross-parallel GW Sensor Network for Aircraft Smart Skin of Structural Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: To implement guided wave (GW)-based aircraft structural health monitoring (SHM), a large number of GW sensors, as well as lead wires, need to be integrated with structures, which adds significant weight and requires the monitoring systems to support a lot of monitoring channels. To solve this problem, a cross-parallel GW sensor network was proposed, as well as its impact and damage monitoring method. The upper electrodes of GW sensors in the same row are connected to one wire, and the lower electrodes of GW sensors in the same column are connected to one wire. Thus, only $M+N$ lead wires are required to support an $M \times N$ cross-parallel GW sensor network to work. For demonstration and verification, a $7 \times 7$ cross-parallel GW sensor network is manufactured and integrated with a glass fiber reinforced plate by a conformal coupling process. Experimental results show that the cross-parallel GW sensor network successfully localized the impact and damage sub-regions. This is of great significance for the realization of lightweight and large-area aircraft SHM smart skin.

articleTitle: Lifetime Prediction of Turbine Blade of Turbocharger for Diesel Engine Based on Fatigue and Creep Damage Model
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: To predict the lifetime of turbocharger turbine blades, a lifetime prediction method based on fatigue-creep damage is proposed. Firstly, by referring to diesel engines on armor vehicles bench test methods, the thermal-structural coupling of a radial turbine blade is analyzed by the finite element method. Based on the stress distribution characteristics of the turbocharger turbine blade, the root of the blade is identified as the dangerous area. Then, the fatigue-creep damage of the turbine blade is calculated and the lifetime is predicted by using the time-life fraction method. Last, the number of the turbine blade’s failure cycles is predicted to be 2956 which are equivalent to 591200km mileage. The proposed method provides a reference basis for predicting the working lifetime of the turbine blades and improving their working reliability.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection Method of Concrete Cracks in Construction Engineering Based on Improved Watershed Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The current method of concrete crack detection is divided into manual method, which is more complex, and it requires higher detection environment and lower detection efficiency and accuracy. Therefore, the automatic detection method of concrete crack in construction engineering is proposed based on the improved watershed algorithm. The high-resolution CCD sensor camera is used to collect the image and to process the image. After the image is segmented by the improved watershed algorithm, the crack features are extracted. The fracture characteristics are classified as decision tree attributes, and decision tree is established to realize automatic crack detection. The simulation results show that the detection error rate of the proposed method is less than 0.3%, and the detection efficiency is higher and the effect is better.

articleTitle: A New Variable Conditions Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Method for Rotor-bearing Based on Vibration Image Dataset
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Modern industrial equipment is developing in the direction of automation and intelligence, and intelligent fault diagnosis based on deep learning (DL) has become a hot topic. Traditional fault diagnosis of rotating machinery is mostly based on the fault data obtained by the accelerometer, which has the problems of sparse vibration information and insignificant vibration characteristics. At the same time, the diagnosis algorithm is mostly based on the assumption that a large amount of labeled samples is available, the training and testing dataset are independent and identically distributed. When the mechanical equipment operates under complex and variable working conditions, the performance of traditional fault diagnosis algorithms will be degenerated. Visual vibration measurement has been gradually applied to the field of mechanical fault diagnosis because it can obtain the full-field vibration information with rich texture characteristics and does not produce mass load effect on the measured object. On this basis, this research proposes a new variable-condition fault diagnosis method based on image dataset, which encodes the full-field time-domain vibration information collected by vision into a gray-scale image sequence to enrich the texture to characterize the fault characteristics, instead of traditional accelerometer data for transfer fault diagnosis. The experimental results show that this method can achieve higher classification and recognition results in the task of fault diagnosis of rotor bearing variable working conditions.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis and Calculation of Aero-engine Main Shaft Bearing Slipping Based on BSS
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: During the operation of an aero-engine, bearing skidding often occurs, causing varying degrees of damage to the rolling elements and raceways, affecting the life of the bearing, and severely restricting the reliability of the engine. In the actual engine operation process, due to the complexity of the system, it is difficult to directly install various sensors on the bearing to measure the speed, vibrating and other signals of the main shaft bearings. At the same time, there are situations where signals are mixed. For this reason, the BSS theory is used to separate the bearing vibration signal, and the cage slipping rate is obtained based on the relationship between the cage slipping and the fault characteristic frequency.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Enhancement of Motion Blurred Image Based on Improved Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the current vision system produces motion blur during imaging, a fast enhancement method for motion blur images based on improved deep learning is proposed. By detecting the contour of the motion blur image target, the Wiener filtering restoration model is established, combined with the improved deep learning method to decompose the gray tone function, and the BNL-Means algorithm is used to calculate the similarity between high-frequency image blocks to improve the accuracy of spatial image feature extraction. Realize the enhancement of motion blurred images. Compared with the existing methods, it is proved by experiments that the accuracy of the fuzzy kernel estimation of the design method reaches 95.63%, which is higher than the comparison of the three literature methods. The method has a better effect of enhancing the motion blur image and has strong practicability.

articleTitle: Accurate multiple-site damage localization of aircraft composite structures under environmental and operational conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: During the long-term use of the aircraft, due to fatigue load and other reasons, composite materials usually suffer Multiple-Site Damages (MSD), which will lead to a rapid decrease in the residual strength of the structure. Therefore, the research of MSD appear very important. In order to monitor MSD, imaging method based on Guided wave (GW) is an effective method. However, aircraft are usually faced with complex environmental and operational conditions (EOCs) when they are in service, which will bring non-negligible uncertainties to the acquired GW signals and cause unreliable damage diagnosis results. Therefore, a MSD imaging method based on GW and Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) is proposed to suppress the influence of EOCs on the GW signals and to realize reliable imaging and localization of MSD. First, by adopting GMM to characterize the EOCs and measuring its variation in the monitoring process, an only sensitive to damage (OSD) feature parameter is proposed to identify the damage subareas. Then, for each recognized damage subarea, the OSD feature signals of every GW path are constructed by GMM to combine with the delay-and-sum (DAS) algorithm and to realize reliable damage imaging under EOCs. Finally, the damage imaging of each subarea are merged to obtain a MSD imaging result, thereby realizing MSD localization. GW signals under varying temperatures of the carbon fiber composite plate was measured by experiment and then processed by the proposed method, and the MSD was located accurately.

articleTitle: Analog circuit degradation location method based on multi-point matching voting
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The wide application of analog circuits makes the health assessment of analog circuits more and more important. The purpose of analog circuit health assessment is to find the degradation of analog circuit in time, replace and repair it in time, and ensure the safe and stable operation of analog circuit. Mahalanobis distance can easily measure the distance between the observed sample and the known sample set, which is very suitable for degradation localization of analog circuits. In this paper, a method of analog circuit degradation device identification considering multi time matching voting of performance parameters is proposed, which improves the traditional Mahalanobis distance degradation location method, selects effective reference data for matching, and adopts the principle of proportion voting for location, so as to make the degradation location of analog circuit more accurate and promote the health assessment of analog circuit.

articleTitle: Demand Analysis of Joint Decision-Making Modeling of Equipment Maintenance and Spare Parts Inventory Based on PHM
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: As the maintenance event and spare parts inventory are mutually influenced, the joint decision-making modeling of equipment maintenance and spare parts inventory should be considered. Moreover, The PHM strategy are more and more important in maintenance modeling and industrial applications. This paper implement the demand analysis of joint decisionmaking modeling of equipment maintenance and spare parts inventory based on PHM. The joint decision factor analysis is built, thus deriving the modeling demand of joint decision.

articleTitle: In-the-loop Simulation Experiment of Aero-engine Fault-tolerant Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The performance simulation model of turbofan engine was established by Microsoft Visual Studio, and the adaptive model was established on this basis to provide accurate analytical redundancy for fault-tolerant control system. Health parameter estimation method is used to obtain the variation of engine measurement parameters after component performance degradation, which solves the inconsistency between model estimation and real engine measurement parameters due to performance degradation and individual differences. In order to verify the performance of the designed fault-tolerant control system, the simulation experiment of the real loop was carried out. Based on the hardware platform of dual-core processor module of NXP QorlQ P2020, the augmented state variable model with Kalman filter is used to modify the adaptive model, so as to estimate the parameter degradation of real engine parts and realize the fault tolerant control of the engine. The simulation results show that the fault-tolerant control of the controller with analytic redundancy for sensor faults on the embedded platform meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Dynamic Diagnosis Method for Continuous and Equidistant Wheel Burn based on Axle Box Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Continuous and equidistant wheel burn (CEWB) of high-speed railway rails will arouse heavy vibrations between the wheels and rails under high-speed conditions, increase the probability of structural damage of the track-vehicle system components, and cause the rails to break in severe cases. Using high-frequency axle box acceleration (ABA), the continuous equidistant wheel burn index (WBI) method of rails is proposed to diagnose CEWB of high-speed railway rails. The continuous equidistance WBI of rails can describe the high-frequency vibration caused by the CEWB of rails. It solves the problem of CEWB cannot be dynamically detected. The new evaluation method uses the demodulated envelope signal of the ABA to replace the original signal, and demodulates the high-frequency discrete response signal into a stable low-frequency energy signal without losing the vibration characteristics. The results of high-speed rail applications show that the new evaluation method can effectively diagnose the of CEWB on rail surface.

articleTitle: Sensor fault detection based on self organizing immune network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: A self-organizing immune network for sensor fault detection in aircraft engine is presented. The self-organizing Map is used in the modeling of sensor immune network. The weights of immune network are determined based on learning vector quantization. The structure and the features of the immune network, for sensor fault detection, are presented, and the algorithms of sensor failure detection are given. Simulation results show that this method can effectively detect the sensor failures. Moreover this method is sensitive to fault and robust for noise interference. This method is contributive for sensors fault detection in aircraft engine and it can be easily extended to other relative industrial application areas.

articleTitle: Research on Establishing Data-driven Diagnosis System of Transformer Winding’s Short-circuit Withstand Ability
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Power transformers will suffer short-circuit shocks during operation. Multiple impacts will cause irreversible damage to the windings. This will gradually reduce the short-circuit withstand ability of the windings, and will eventually cause the transformer to lose stability and shutdown. In order to discover this problem in time, this paper proposes a method of establishing a data-driven diagnosis system for winding short-circuit withstand ability. First, the voltage, current and vibration signals of the transformer are transmitted to the cloud server platform through the Internet of Things technology; Secondly, obtain the current state characteristic information of the transformer through cloud computing; Repeat the above process to collect a large amount of data about the normal operation and fault operation status of the transformer to construct a Random Forest diagnosis model. Finally, input the characteristic data at the current moment, and the diagnostic model automatically decides whether the transformer is in a winding fault state. Experiments show that the diagnostic system has excellent evaluation accuracy, and the system is practical.

articleTitle: Design of wireless transmitting power amplifier chip applied to the Internet of Things in smart cities
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: With the advent of the era of basic network construction of smart cities, the Internet of Things has gradually been put on the agenda, and the term “smart city” in the Internet of Things has gradually become known and implemented. In the era of the Internet of Things, communication equipment is indispensable. As a radio frequency front end, the power amplifier is a very important module in the field of wireless communication. This article mainly studies the transmitter module in communication equipment, designs and manufactures the power amplifier in the transmitter module. The class D amplifier designed in this article uses an inverter as the basic structure, with a simple structure, a theoretical efficiency of 100%, and a large transmission power. Class D amplifiers are often used in occasions with constant envelope modulation signals such as GFSK and GMSK and high requirements for the efficiency and output power of the power amplifier.

articleTitle: Intelligent Acquisition Method of English Online Voice Teaching Information Based on Praat System
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Existing voice teaching information collection methods have the problem of low accuracy of collection results. In order to improve the similarity between the echo path and the original audio, this research designed a new intelligent collection method of English online voice teaching information based on the praat system. First, briefly describe the application of the praat system in English online phonetic teaching, including the method of use and its role in the English phonetic teaching class. Then based on the praat system, the teaching audio information is accurately extracted, and a zero-phase filter constant is constructed to process the objective function, and the modal constant is used as the core to reconstruct the detailed conditions to obtain the redundant structure of the analysis operator.
