Based on the experimental scheme, the theory of compressible gas isentropic flow and RNG-k-$\varepsilon$ The turbulence model establishes the transient mathematical model of explosion decompression, studies the influencing factors of decompression time, carries out explosion decompression simulation analysis based on ANSYS Workbench platform, and quantitatively analyzes the influencing factors. The simulation results show that reducing the initial pressure of the low-pressure chamber can effectively reduce the decompression time. When the initial pressure drops to 10kPa and below, the decompression time is about 70ms. The lag time of the pressure change at the monitoring point compared with the pressure change at the product placement point accounts for about 15% of the total decompression time. Combined with the simulation and test data, a scheme optimization method is proposed. The design pressure drop area falls within 90% of the total pressure drop area, which can make the decompression time meet the requirements of explosion decompression test.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Electronic Cabin Smoke Detector Based on FMEA and Arrhenius Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The high reliability of smoke detectors in the electronic cabin of passenger aircraft is of great significance for reducing the false alarm rate of smoke detection and ensuring the safety of passenger aircraft and passengers. In order to analyze and evaluate the reliability of newly developed smoke detectors, a set of reliability evaluation methods for electronic cabin smoke detectors based on FMEA (failure mode and impact analysis) and Arrhenius models are presented. First of all, based on the principle of the system, the FMEA method is used to analyze and determine the potential failure location, potential failure mode and failure reason of the smoke detector. Then, the RPN (Risk Coefficient) evaluation method based on the expert scoring method determines the priority ranking of failure risks, establishes risk evaluation indicators, conducts risk evaluation on failure modes, and determines high-risk stresses. Finally, for the high-risk stress, a life prediction of the smoke detector in the electronic cabin based on the Arrhenius model is established. The feasibility and effectiveness of the above reliability evaluation method are verified and analyzed by taking a smoke detector in the electronic cabin of a certain type of passenger aircraft as an example.

articleTitle: Reliability Calculation of Solid Propellant Based on Accelerated Degradation Test
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: With the improvement of solid propellant reliability, the collection of failure data of test is facing severe challenges. In view of the difficulty in evaluating the reliability of solid propellant, a method for calculating the reliability of solid propellant based on accelerated degradation test is proposed. Firstly, according to the performance degradation data of solid propellant, the performance degradation models with multiple groups of samples under multiple accelerated stress levels are determined by linear regression method. Combined with the failure threshold, multiple pseudo lifetimes at each accelerated stress level are obtained. Then the pseudo-life distributions under different accelerating stress levels are tested. Finally, the maximum likelihood estimation method is used to estimate parameters of accelerated model, and the reliability function of solid propellant storage life is derived. The example shows that the reliability of a solid propellant stored at an alternating environment with the low temperature $15^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ and the high temperature $25^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ for 18 years is 0.9027. It shows that the reliability of solid propellant under an arbitrary stress level can be evaluated by the accelerated degradation test data.

articleTitle: A Wiener Process Model With Kernel-based Time Transformation For Nonlinear Degradation Data
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Degradation processes of complex systems generally have two key characteristics: nonlinearity and stochasticity. The stochastic process degradation models with nonlinear transformation functions are widely used in degradation modeling, such as Wiener process model with an exponential term. However, the exponential terms for time transformation are not suitable for the nonlinear degradation processes which caused by complex failure mechanisms. To capture the nonlinear characteristics more accurately, this study proposes a nonlinear Wiener process model with kernel-based time transformation for nonlinear degradation analysis. A Bayesian estimation method is developed for parameter estimation. Compared with the experimental results of linear Wiener model, exponential Wiener model and RVM model, the effectiveness and universality of the method proposed in this paper is verified among different degradation curves of several products.

articleTitle: An Optimal DAG-LSTSVM Algorithm Based on Imbalance Factor for Vehicle Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In recent years, health monitoring for vehicles has become increasingly important. The Internet of Vehicles (IoV) is inevitably susceptible to various faults due to its dynamic structure and variable environment, which has a serious impact on system performance and can even lead to traffic accidents. Therefore, it is critical to investigate the health management and fault diagnosis for vehicles. Conventional diagnosis schemes, such as signal-based methods, suffer from significant drawbacks because of poor coupling detection performances. Hence, data-driven methods have been proposed and widely applied. Among these, Support Vector Machine (SVM) and its variants, such as Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) and Least Squares Twin (LST) SVM, show excellent performance in vehicle fault diagnosis. Nevertheless, those algorithms have weaknesses of low diagnostic efficiency and are incapable of dealing with the imbalanced classification. To address these shortcomings, this paper proposes a novel multi-classification algorithm for vehicle health management, called Imbalance Factor (IF) based LSTSVM. Firstly, to address the problem of multi-classification, the discriminable metric (DM) between different classes is proposed and utilized as the measurement to construct the optimal DAG structure. Further, considering the effect of imbalance classification, IF is employed in SVM classifiers to alleviate this issue, which leads to a higher accuracy rate. Moreover, taking advantage of LSTSVM, the proposed algorithm achieves high efficiency. Experiments on the typical datasets reveal its superiority in vehicle fault diagnosis. Experimental results show that compared with the existing methods, the proposed algorithm has obvious advantages in terms of classification accuracy and efficiency.

Author Keywords: Least Square Twin Support Vector Machine

articleTitle: Fast fusion method of marine environment vector data based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The fast fusion method of marine environment vector data currently studied requires high light wave resolution in the panchromatic band and multi-spectral band, and the fused data is relatively fuzzy. In view of the above problems, a new marine environment vector based on BP neural network is studied. Fast data fusion method, accurate data acquisition operation, the data is arranged according to the filter length, system collection and filtering operations are performed according to the arrangement standard, and effective data is obtained. Even the low-resolution data can be well after the filtering operation. Fusion, based on the collected data, effectively analyze the fusion rules, combine the data wavelength center point to perform point data collection operations, combine the collected data, improve the system combination performance, and record the data that meets the combination standard as a fusion The standards are stored in the system space. Finally, the fusion criteria are used to perform data fusion operations to match the data fusion similarity, and the data that meets the system similarity standards are retained, and irrelevant data parameters are filtered to achieve accurate and automated data fusion. The experimental results show that the fast fusion method of marine environment vector data based on BP neural network can analyze the light wave resolution of panchromatic band and multispectral band well, and can realize high-definition data fusion.

articleTitle: Research on network news information dissemination planning path based on Knowledge Map
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Today’s society has entered the information age, the traditional way of news communication is not consistent with the development of the times, the relevant departments must actively apply new technology. In order to solve the above problems, this paper studies the network news information dissemination planning path based on knowledge map. Starting from the overview of knowledge mapping, this paper introduces its definition, characteristics and digital media; At the same time, it analyzes the change of news communication under the knowledge map, and lists the promotion path of news communication under the knowledge map; This paper expounds the application significance of network information in news communication, and puts forward effective strategies for news communication, so as to provide reliable reference for relevant departments.

articleTitle: Vibration Characteristics Analysis Of A Double-Suction Centrifugal Pump Identified By Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Due to the merits of high flow rate and high lift, double-suction centrifugal pumps are widely used for agricultural irrigation along the Yellow River in northern China. The operational conditions of the pump are highly related to the silt concentration and flow rates. Therefore, it is crucial to identify the vibration characteristics corresponding to different silt concentrations and flow rates to provide a prior guideline for pump condition monitoring. To this end, this paper explores the identification capabilities of typical intelligent models, including convolutional neural network (CNN), deep neural network (DNN), and support vector machine (SVM), to intelligently establish the connection between vibration characteristics and different flow rates and silt concentrations. Experimental studies on a double-section pump covering a range of flow rates and different silt concentrations are conducted. The results show that CNN features higher identification accuracy than DNN and SVM.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Aircraft Power Supply System Based on Factoring Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The reliable operation of the aircraft power supply system is an important factor in ensuring the safe flight of the aircraft. Taking an aircraft HVDC power supply system as an example, a reliability assessment method suitable for large aircraft power supply networks is introduced. With the goal of ensuring that all bus bars are supplied with power, the method uses graph theory and other related knowledge to transform the aircraft power supply network into a cyclic directed rooted communication network. Thereby converting the problem into solving the network%s rooted communication reliability; then using factoring algorithm performs binary tree decomposition on the generated rooted communication network to gradually reduce the network scale, and put forward the rules for selecting points that can improve the efficiency of the algorithm. Finally, in the process of generating the binary tree, the overall reliability function of the network can be obtained, so that typical reference indicators such as reliability and MTBF can be calculated.

articleTitle: A Simulation-based Study of the Effects of Incomplete Data on Lifetime Distribution Estimation due to Censorship
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Truncation and censoring are often observed in lifetime data, the data condition will be more complex in the railway wagon industry due to the observational constraints, periodic inspection, and new model updating. In this paper, we extract the data scenarios from actual problems, then generate the data under different censoring scenarios through Monte Carlo method, the maximum likelihood estimation method is employed to get the numerical solutions. Certain evaluation indexes are used to determine the tendency of estimation bias. Model discrimination is also studied to describe the influence by misuse. Finally, suggestions to further improve the accuracy of lifetime models are provided.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Reconstruction Method of High-Resolution Image Based on Independently Adjustable Sparse Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Image 3D reconstruction is widely used in reverse engineering, artificial intelligence and other fields. In order to better guarantee the quality of 3D image reconstruction, this research proposes a 3D reconstruction method for high-resolution images based on independently adjustable sparsity coefficients. A single image is used to reconstruct a three-dimensional model, and then combined with the sparse coefficients, the local features of the single image three-dimensional reconstruction are collected and analyzed, and local denoising is performed. On this basis, the image information is corrected and reconstructed. By comparing the experimental results, it can be known that this method has high practicability and can effectively meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Design approaches of a can premixed combustor for a micro-gas turbine
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This study analyzes the working features of the micro-gas turbine combustors used in the distributed energy system, and takes the can premixed combustor as the design purpose, and integrates the existing design experience to establish the design approach of a initial structure of the can combustor with the maximum cross-sectional area determined by the pressure loss method, the dilution hole arrangement scheme determined by the equivalent area method. To verify the effectiveness of the design approach, the flow and heat transfer process of the designed results is simulated by numerical simulation software. The simulation results show that the combustor designed by this method can meet the design requirements of the pressure loss coefficient, the combustion efficiency, OTDF, and the maximum wall temperature under rated operating conditions. Moreover, stably burn still can be observed when the load reduces to only 30% of the rated power, which can adapt to the demand of variable load of power equipment in the distributed energy system.

articleTitle: Integrated Measurement System of Three Parameters of Turboprop Engine Based on Novel Phonic Wheel
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Sensor is the foundation of aero-engine health management. In turboprop engine measurement system, in order to effectively solve the problems of multi-sensor installation space and unbalance of phonic wheel rotor, an integrated measurement system of propeller pitch, phase angle and speed of turboprop engine based on novel phonic wheel was studied. A novel phonic wheel structure with multiple regular teeth and a set of symmetrically marker helical teeth is proposed, the sensor waveform is modulated into square wave through the signal processing module, and the propeller pitch, phase angle and speed of propeller can be obtained by analyzing the edge time of the square wave. Using numerical simulation of COMSOL, the influence of different phonic wheel structures on voltage waveform and measurement accuracy were studied. Simulation results show that the error curves of propeller pitch and phase angle show good linear characteristics in the non-extreme ranges of difference angle of teeth. Under the condition of no error compensation, the measurement errors of propeller pitch, phase angle and speed can be maintained within -0.35mm$\sim 0.05mm, 0^{\circ}\sim 0.11^{\circ}$and $0.01\sim 0.01$r/min separately, which can meet the control accuracy requirements of turboprop engine.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant Control Scheme for the Sensor Fault in the Transition Process of Variable Cycle Engine
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper presents a fault-tolerant control (FTC) scheme for the sensor fault in the transition process of variable cycle engine (VCE) based on an adaptive equilibrium manifold model. Firstly, an adaptive equilibrium manifold model (AEMM) with multiple inputs and multiple outputs is established. Combined with the Kalman filter bank, sensor fault diagnosis is carried out to realize the diagnosis and signal reconstruction of the engine in the case of the single sensor and double sensor fault. On this basis, a sensor FTC scheme in the transient process of VCE is proposed, which uses the rotational speed for the closed-loop control. Finally, a hardware-in-loop (HIL) simulation platform is built based on the idea of distributed control. The FTC scheme of the sensor during the acceleration process of VCE is verified based on this platform. The results show that the fault tolerance scheme can accurately diagnose the fault of the low-pressure speed sensor during the acceleration process. After the fault, the analytic redundancy of the on-board model is used to replace the faulty sensor value to continue the closed-loop control, which ensures the reliability of the acceleration process.

articleTitle: EFMEA-Based Design of Prognostics and Health Management System for Heavy Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Due to the volatile environment and operation condition of heavy vehicles, the prognostics and health management (PHM) for heavy vehicles has leveraged a rapid development of economical failure reduction and efficient condition-based maintenance (CBM) for heavy vehicles. This manuscript proposes a framework for the design of PHM system for heavy vehicles, which combines the failure mechanics and extended FMEA (eFMEA) with the PHM design workflow. Addressed issues in this manuscript are: failure mechanics and eFMEA for PHM systems, real-time diagnostics and deep prognostics design for vehicle failures, in which the principles, restrictions, and items of analysis are introduced, respectively. Based on the proposed design framework, we design a distributed-centralized PHM system for heavy vehicles, which are deployed both on the vehicles and on the bases. The PHM system combines the failure detection, prediction, and maintenance task support based on the proposed real-time failure diagnostics and deep failure prognostics, and eventually provides an integrated and economical solution for heavy vehicle fleet operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Blade Tip-timing Measurement Mathematical Modeling and Simulation Without OPR Under the Condition of Rotating Speed Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The tip-timing measurement without the OPR (once-per-revolution) signals is a non-contact blade vibration measurement method. It measures blade vibration by monitoring the time of arrival (ToA) of the blade. It affects the accuracy of the ToA that including blade assembly mistuning, coupled vibration, rotating speed fluctuation, measurement system noise, etc. However, it is difficult to complete the study of the influencing factors of this method due to the lack of a standard tip-timing data source. This paper derived the relationship between rotating speed fluctuation, vibration displacement, and the ToA. The model simulating the tip-timing measurement without OPR was established. This model realized the simulation of tip-timing measurement without OPR under the condition of rotating speed fluctuation. It can provide the standard tip-timing data for performance verification of the tip-timing measurement method without OPR. Besides, the measurement accuracy of the linear fitting method without OPR was verified, and the factors influencing the fitting accuracy were analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Prediction Method of Rolling Bearing Based on Health Indicator and Dynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of rolling bearing fault prediction in gradual degradation mode, this paper proposes a rolling bearing fault prediction method based on Health Indicator (HI) and dynamic model from the perspective of initial fault detection and prediction model construction. Firstly, multiple His that can represent the degradation state of rolling bearings are mined. Then, based on the amplitude variation trend of multiple His, rolling bearing health status identification is carried out to complete the initial fault detection. Secondly, aiming at the problem of model construction in different degradation stages of rolling bearings, the dynamic model-based strategy is adopted to optimize the parameters of the prediction model based on fault observation samples, so as to complete the prediction and evaluation of Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of rolling bearings. The experimental data verification results of rolling bearings show that the proposed method can achieve relatively ideal fault prediction results.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Estimation Based On Feature Reconstruction And Variational Bayesian Inferences
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The prediction of remaining useful life (RUL) plays an important role in prognostics and health management (PHM) to improve the reliability of machines and reduce the cycle cost of mechanical systems. In recent years, deep learning (DL) for RUL prediction has become increasingly popular with the dramatic increase in computational power and has yielded a large number of results in research. However, most DL learning prediction frameworks tend to provide only a point estimate, but there is relatively less research on the uncertainty of the prediction and the confidence interval of the prediction results. This paper proposes a variational inferential Bayesian method to enhance the study of prediction result uncertainty, consequently, the output of prediction result changes from a point estimate to a confidence interval output. To improve the prediction accuracy, the feature are extracted and reconstructed, which make the feature degradation more recognizable. Furthermore, an attention mechanism is considered to improve the performance of RUL prediction by assigning weights to the input features. The effectiveness of our proposed method is validated with a publicly available dataset and compared with the-state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Intelligent Big Data Hybrid Information System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In the intelligent big data hybrid information system, the index parameters of the binary semantic interval are too few, which leads to large idle parameters in reliability analysis and occupying more system resources. In response to the above problems, intelligent big data mixed information is analyzed based on the reliability of the artificial intelligence system. Use artificial intelligence technology to sort and process information operation tasks, construct homomorphic mapping information relationships, define weight parameters generated by index semantics, control the idleness of indicators generated by reliability algorithms, construct reliability analysis algorithms, and finally complete the analysis process. Prepare the known software and hardware environment of the intelligent big data hybrid information system, and apply the reliability analysis method based on state information, the reliability analysis method based on cloud computing, and the designed reliability analysis method for experiments. The results show that the designed reliability analysis method actually occupies less operating resources of the information system, and the processing time is short. High reliability analysis accuracy.

articleTitle: Component detection of electronic ceramic composite in battery based on CNN convolution neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: When the common methods are used to detect the composition of composite materials, the detection time is long and the accuracy is low. Therefore, a method based on CNN convolution neural network is proposed to detect the composition of electronic ceramic composite materials in batteries. The near-infrared image of the lossless area of the electronic ceramic composite is collected by locating the lossless area of the electronic ceramic composite and keeping the battery in a high temperature state. Through color correction and geometric correction, the near-infrared image is preprocessed, and the image features are extracted. Then the image features are input into CNN convolution neural network to iteratively train and learn the image features and judge the composition of the electronic ceramic composite. The experimental results show that the design method improves the detection accuracy of composite material composition and shortens the detection time.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of RCV Letdown Flow Based on LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Artificial neural networks have been widely used in the research of fault diagnosis in various fields. The application of neural networks is limited due to the complex and interconnected systems of nuclear power plants. Based on the fault evolution process of the letdown flow in chemical and volume control system (RCV), the paper analyzes and decomposes the function of the letdown flow and uses the long short term memory (LSTM) network to create a method of fault diagnosis. After a certain amount of training in the nuclear power plant simulator, the accuracy rate of fault diagnosis is satisfactory.

articleTitle: An Aeroengine Fault Diagnosis Method Based on UTCA and DBN
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Because the aeroengine measurement samples at different operating points are unbalanced, the diagnosis accuracy of the fault diagnosis model changes in the whole flight envelope. To solve the problem, a fault diagnosis method UDBN based on unsupervised transfer component analysis (UTCA) and deep belief network (DBN) was proposed in this paper. UTCA preprocessing maps the source domain dataset and target domain dataset to high-dimension space. Through optimizing the kernel function, the distance between the two datasets becomes closer enough. Then the mapped source domain dataset is used to train the DBN model, and the mapped target domain dataset is used to test the model performance. The UDBN model was validated through simulation experiments, and the results show that the model has high diagnosis accuracy at different operating points.

articleTitle: Extraction of Solar Cell Model Parameters Based on Quantum Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The extraction of solar cell model parameters is of great value for diagnosing the ageing fault of solar cells and predicting the life of solar cells. Aiming at improving the accuracy of solar cell parameter extraction, quantum theory is introduced to enhance the algorithm's global search ability and local mining ability of whale optimization algorithm. The extraction of solar cell model parameters are carried out with the whale optimization algorithm and the Harris Eagle algorithm at the same time. The comparison and results proved that the QWOA(quantum whale optimization algorithm) has high accuracy and rapidity in the extraction of solar cell model parameters.

articleTitle: Quantitative Identification of Crack Faults in Aviation Hydraulic Pipeline Based on Multifractal Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The vibration mechanism of aviation hydraulic pipeline is complex, and the fault signal interference coupling. Moreover, the fault characterization is not obvious, and the identification rate of early crack fault and propagation is not high. In order to address the above problems, a fault diagnosis method based on multifractal and local linear identification was proposed in this paper to carry out fractal analysis on vibration signal with the generalized dimension. It was analyzed from the general dimension correlation coefficient spectrum diagram and the general dimension correlation coefficient change law that, the general dimension correlation coefficient can identify the early fault of crack and the crack propagation. The model space sample database was established by means of multifractal diagnosis method to identify the pending signals of any crack fault, and the local linear identification method was used to perform simulation analysis on the pending vibration signals. The results showed that the fractal theory can be used to quantitatively identify the crack fault length in aviation hydraulic pipe.

articleTitle: Non-destructive testing method of bridge pile foundation based on elastic wave reflection method
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: the current process of non-destructive testing of bridge pile foundations, due to the poor signal filtering ability of the detection method, the accuracy of the detection results is reduced, and the daily maintenance of the bridge is adversely affected. In order to improve the reliability of testing results, a non-destructive testing method for bridge pile foundation based on elastic wave reflection method is designed. Collect elastic wave detection data, use waveform signal separation method to realize signal preprocessing. According to the processed signal, the reflection information of the pile top after being excited is analyzed. Introduce this part of the data into the ANSYS program to determine the condition and damage location of the bridge pile foundation. So far, the design of the non-destructive testing method for bridge pile foundation based on elastic wave reflection method is completed. Constructing a case analysis link, the experimental results show that the elastic wave detection method can effectively improve the accuracy of the detection results and ensure the reliability of the detection results.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Aeroengine Ball Bearing Skid Using Adaptive Threshold
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Ball bearing plays an important role in aeroengine. However, spindle ball bearing often appears slipping fault, which affects the operation of the whole machine. Therefore, we design a fault diagnosis strategy based on adaptive threshold for the analysis of aeroengine ball bearing skid fault. Firstly, in view of the characteristics of ball bearing slip faults that are disturbed by many uncertain factors and are not obvious, the bearing slip rate is selected as the technical index of fault diagnosis after research. Secondly, according to the range of bearing slip rate studied in this paper, an adaptive threshold function algorithm is designed to determine the appropriate threshold for fault diagnosis. Finally, the fault diagnosis algorithm is written to obtain the diagnosis results. The effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by dynamics software analysis. The simulation results show that the fault diagnosis algorithm proposed in this paper can accurately diagnose the skid fault of the ball bearing, and has high diagnostic accuracy.

articleTitle: A bi-level condition-based maintenance policy for a two-component system subject to stochastic and economic dependencies
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper investigates a condition-based maintenance policy for a two-component system subject to stochastic and economic dependencies. The stochastic dependence between components is modeled by a copula function. The economic dependence is represented by combination of maintenance activities of components as a group. A decision-making process considering both system and component levels is proposed. At the system level, the decision rule is to derive the optimal system reliability threshold which triggers the maintenance actions of components given the system’s current health state. At the component level, a maintenance efficacy indicator is proposed to support the selection of the optimal group of components to be preventively replaced. The objective is to minimize the average long-run maintenance cost rate. The grid search method and Monte Carlo simulation are jointly used to derive the optimal CBM decision. A numerical study is conducted to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in the maintenance optimization framework. A sensitivity analysis of several model parameters is also performed.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Model of Turboshaft Engine with Surge Process
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: At present, the main data source for the verification of surge detection devices still relies on the surge test of the compressor or the whole engine which makes it urgent to study the simulation methods of the whole engine surge process to replace the high-cost and high-risk surge test. To solve this problem, a turboshaft engine component level model (CLM) is established firstly and then the compressor characteristic lines are expanded in the classic Moore-Greitzer (MG) model to establish an extended MG model. Finally, a novel real-time surge model based on the surge mechanism for simulating the turboshaft engine dynamic process of surge is proposed with considering the coupling relationship between compressor’s rotor speed, mass flow and pressure of CLM and extended MG model. The simulation results show that the model can realize the whole-process simulation of the whole process of steady—surge—steady under multiple operating states of the engine. The change characteristics of the rotor speed, compressor outlet pressure, mass flow, exhaust gas temperature and other parameters are consistent with the test data, which means this model can be further applied to the simulation test research of surge detection and anti-surge control.

articleTitle: Sparsity-assisted Supervised Classification Approach with Application to Data-driven Machine Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Data-driven machine diagnostics is vital to intelligent maintenance and operation of various modern complex industrial systems. However, classical data-driven fault diagnosis techniques depend upon manually designed features or the expert knowledge, which greatly limits their applicability in automatic and intelligent diagnostic system. In this study, a new sparsity-assisted supervised classification (SASC) approach is proposed to learn discriminative features automatically for robust fault diagnosis. Our proposed SASC approach involves two stages for dictionary design and fault recognition. First, SASC designs the structured whole dictionary in a data-driven way considering the self-similarity information of vibration data within and across multiple health states. Second, SASC implements fault recognition using a sparse classification strategy based on the minimal reconstruction errors. Compared to classical data-driven fault diagnosis methods, SASC can get rid of the manual feature design and selection, enabling automatic and robust fault diagnosis. The SASC approach has been verified with gearbox datasets in the 2009 IEEE PHM data challenge. Besides, comparison results with several traditional sparse representation-based classification approaches prove the superiority of the SASC approach for data-driven machine diagnostics.

articleTitle: Research on SLAM Algorithm of Mobile Robot Vision Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: With the development of the automation industry in recent years, simultaneous positioning and mapping (SLAM) has been used in many fields such as mobile robots. Although visual SLAM has no detection distance limit, it would be easily affected by the environment, which causes inaccurate visual feature matching and cumulative error in map construction. The visual SLAM is studied which is about framework and algorithm in this paper. Aiming at the problem of insufficient front-end natural feature extraction accuracy, a method combined with artificial feature extraction is proposed. The Gauss-Seidel relaxation method is fused with Mobile Netv3-KPCA to solve the problem about low efficiency of traditional back-end optimization algorithms. The contradiction between closed-loop detection accuracy and real-time performance is discussed. An ideological framework combined with neural network is proposed for it. Traditional visual SLAM has limitations in the construction of high dynamic scenes. To address the problem, the geometric constraint method and progressive consistent sampling are used to filter out dynamic features. Dense point cloud construction thread is added to achieve the optimization of the ORB-SLAM2 framework. After analyzing the application of SLAM and path planning in dynamic environment, an experimental platform for robot indoor travel and corridor obstacle avoidance are constructed. The optimization framework based on ORB-SLAM2 and path planning method based on the A* algorithm are both studied in the end.

articleTitle: Vibration Signal Analysis of Rolling Bearing Based on Permutation Entropy
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Permutation entropy (PE) is usually used as a statistical feature combined with classification algorithms to identify the state of rolling bearings and has achieved high recognition accuracy. The purpose of this paper is to study the potential behavior of PE at varying parameters in rolling bearing vibration signals for the normal state and three fault states (including inner race, outer race, and ball fault). The influence of the vibration signal length (N) and the parameter embedding dimension (m) on the PE were studied, and the signal length when they reached stability was analyzed. Then PE with varying signal lengths of each state at m=3 and m=5 was compared. Finally, the ordinal patterns found and their relative frequency in each state’s vibration signal with varying m were analyzed, and the differences were discussed. The results indicated that the different states of rolling bearing could be effectively distinguished with a shorter time series than the $N \gg m !$ recommendation. PE could sensitively distinguish between the normal state and fault states, which may be due to the difference in the number of ordinal patterns found at the same length signal and the difference in relatively high-frequency ordinal pattern types and their relative frequency. The identification of outer race and ball fault is more difficult than that of inner race fault by PE, which may be due to the fact that the ordinal patterns and their relative frequency in the vibration signals between the outer race and ball fault are similar to a certain extent, while inner race fault is different from them.

articleTitle: Vibration Analysis of a Marine Propulsion Shaft System with the Torsional-longitudinal Coupling Effect Induced by Propeller and Crankshaft
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Due to the complicated structure and harsh working environment, the marine propulsion shaft suffers from excessive vibrations in torsional, longitudinal and their coupled vibration modes. The coupled torsional-longitudinal effect is mainly induced by two factors, namely the propeller additional water and the crankshaft structure. However, most of previous models were established with only one coupling factor, and consequently there is still a lack of a complete understanding for coupled torsional-longitudinal vibration. Hence, a comprehensive investigation is performed in this work to reveal deeper mechanisms of coupled torsional-longitudinal vibrations for marine propulsion shaft system. A discrete torsional-longitudinal vibration model is established for a real-life marine shaft. The coupling effects due to propeller additional water and dynamic characteristics of crankshaft are considered simultaneously to model the realistic vibration conditions. Then, a theoretical analysis is conducted on a simplified model to present a theoretical basis. Natural frequencies and forced steady-state responses are calculated numerically to analyze the influences of coupled torsional-longitudinal effect on the eigenvalue problem and vibration characteristics. Results show that, both the propeller additional water and the crankshaft structure could induce coupled torsional-longitudinal vibrations, and should be considered simultaneously in the model to achieve accurate vibration prediction and analysis. Besides, the coupling effect could induce a high amplitude beyond expectation that may even threaten the structure safe. The theoretical and numerical results in this study could provide some suggestions to designers and researchers attempting to obtain desirable vibration behaviors for marine propulsion shafts.

articleTitle: Distributed fault-tolerant adaptive flocking control of multi-agent system with model perturbation and actuator failure
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper investigates the fault-tolerant flocking control problem for a class of multi-agent system including uncertainty, disturbance and actuator fault, which make it hard to design the fault-tolerant control law for agents. We propose a novel distributed flocking control law combining the cooperative protocol and the robust adaptive mechanism using parameter updating. Design of the control parameters is then addressed to achieve the velocity consensus and the fault-tolerance against failure. Simulation results illustrate the rationality and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Development of an Online Fault-Diagnostic-System Based on STM32 for Actuators
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In the process of fault diagnosis for complicated mechatronic equipment such as actuators, the fault diagnosis method is usually calculated on the equipment side. When computing devices are not easy to be installed at the object end, the embedded device can be used for real-time diagnosis, so as to meet the requirement of no network, low bandwidth, low power consumption, and low delay, at the same time improve the availability of the fault diagnosis device. While ensuring the recognition rate and the diagnosis effect, the security, and portability of the equipment are improved. In this paper, an online fault diagnosis system for mechatronic actuators based on the STM32 embedded platform is developed. This system uses a backpropagation neural network and a support vector machine fusion model to diagnose the actuator faults and reduces the memory usage by compressing the model, discretizing the attributes, and reducing the number of input features. Real-time data acquisition, feature extraction, fusion fault diagnosis, and data storage are implemented on this embedded system.

articleTitle: Fault Feature Extraction Method of Rotating Machinery Based on DeepLabV3+ Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The requirements for the health status of rotating machinery equipment continue to increase, and traditional fault diagnosis methods cannot efficiently and intelligently process the collected large-capacity rotating machinery fault test data. In the paper, we combine the advantages of time-frequency representation and deep learning semantic segmentation, and propose the Fault Feature Extraction Method of Rotating Machinery Based on DeepLabV3+ Semantic Segmentation. First, the continuous wavelet transform is used to represent the fault vibration signals in different health states in time-frequency, so as to fully represent the time-varying and non-stationary fault characteristic information of different faults and the time-varying frequency characteristic information. Then in order to efficiently and intelligently identify these features and use them as segmentation targets, a DeepLabV3+ deep learning semantic segmentation model is constructed to accurately extract information of different fault categories. Finally, the model is trained and tested with the rolling bearing failure data, and the influence of the number of training samples on the performance of the model is analyzed. The accuracy of the background and fault features are 87.20% and 92.21%, respectively. The total accuracy of the DeepLabV3+ model is 89.5%, the Kappa coefficient is 0.7895, and the loss is 0.1109. The results prove that the proposed method can accurately extract fault features from a large number of time-frequency representations.

articleTitle: KRCs Driven Product Manufacturing Quality Improvement Approach Using DMAIC
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Product reliability-oriented quality improvement in the manufacturing stage has great significance to reduce the loss of product design reliability during manufacturing process. Therefore, a novel KRCs (key reliability characteristics) driven product manufacturing quality improvement approach with the aid of Six sigma DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control) procedure is proposed. First, the connotation of product manufacturing reliability and product KRCs are presented, then the degradation mechanism of product manufacturing reliability is expounded; Second, on the basis of degradation mechanism of product manufacturing reliability, an identification and decomposition method based on QFD and VMEA for product KRCs is put forward; Third, a KRCs driven product manufacturing quality improvement approach by adopting DMAIC is established, and the key technique of Response surface methodology based tolerance optimization is expounded. Finally, a key subway parts manufacturing quality improvement example is provided to verify the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Inspection and Diagnosis Robots for Plant Facilities-Trajectory Tracking Control by Fuzzy Genetic Algorithm and Self-Positioning Correction Method by Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper proposes an autonomous trajectory tracking control method for automatic intelligent inspection and diagnosis robots (IIDR) in various factories. Firstly, the basic concept of IIDR system is described. Fuzzy trajectory tracking control rules for automatic walking along the inspection path when IIDR automatic inspection equipment is built. And a method to explore the best fuzzy control rules based on multi-objective genetic algorithm (MOGA) is proposed. In order to solve the positioning error of IIDR during automatic walking, an automatic position correction method based on deep learning Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is proposed. The result of the method is very accurate. Finally, the effectiveness of the various methods proposed in this paper is verified by using typical vehicle experiments.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Design and Investigation of Civil Aircraft Reliability /Maintainability/Safety/Testability Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Reliability, safety, maintainability, and testability (RMST) are collectively referred to as civil aircraft features. Excellent feature design and realization are important features that distinguish civil aircraft from other types of aircraft. This paper considers the design features of civil aircrafts of high safety and reliability, excellent maintainability and testability. Starting from the lowest level design requirements, a comprehensive design analysis and research on the quantitative and qualitative aspects of feature design is carried out. Through research, it is found that MTBF and dispatch reliability quantitative indicators that reflect reliability are important design inputs for maintainability MTTR (Mean Time To Repair), NFFR(No Fault Found Rate), and safety FHA(Functional Hazard Assessment) and CCA(Common Cause Analysis) design. Especially the level of component MTBF (Mean Time Between Failure) is an aircraft that reflects market competitiveness. Cornerstone. The architecture design of aircraft and systems, and the arrangement and installation of component locations are from another perspective to improve the design level of aircraft and systems. Through good redundant architecture design and appropriate component layout and installation, the reliability of aircraft dispatch is made. The feature indexes such as MTTR and CCA can be correctly realized.

articleTitle: Ability Oriented Modular Talent Training Plan – Taking Architecture as An Example
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The training goal of application-oriented universities is to cultivate high-quality application-oriented talents with strong social adaptability and competitiveness. It is required that the cultivation of various majors should be closely combined with local characteristics and highlight the improvement of students’ application ability. Based on the above background, this paper puts forward the ability oriented modular talent training program, taking architecture as an example. Starting from the purpose of Application-oriented Colleges and universities, this paper uses the teaching achievements of colleges and universities to reform the existing curriculum structure system, analyzes and explains the problems existing in the current talent training mode of architecture major in Colleges and universities, and constructs a modular teaching system oriented by ability output, combined with the training mode of application-oriented talents, guided by professional ability, and adheres to the principle of integrating theory with practice Based on the principle of combining engineering certification, a complete modular architecture teaching system is constructed. In order to provide reference for the talent training mode of domestic application-oriented universities, it should formulate and explore the idea and talent training scheme of modular reform of Architecture Specialty in line with the orientation of the University.

articleTitle: Fault diagnose of the rolling bearings vibration signals based on Kalman filter method
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Kalman filter method is used to analyze the rolling bearings vibration signals under different fault states. Kalman filter based detection method is effective for the rolling bearings. The description of state space equations of the rolling bearings is firstly given based on Autoregressive(AR) model of its responses. Then a practical strategy of detection method is proposed for vibration signals of the rolling bearings based on the Kalman filter. Fault diagnose of the rolling bearings are confirmed by Kalman filter.

articleTitle: Detection of Delamination Defects in Carbon Fiber Composites based on Infrared Thermal Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper designs a test piece of pre-built delamination defects inside the composite laminate. Six different sizes of Teflon films are preset inside the T700S/MTC811 carbon fiber/epoxy carbon fiber composite laminate to simulate the interior layering defect of the composite laminate. Infrared thermal imaging detection system is used to detect the interior defect of the composite laminate. The infrared image obtained is used to extract the damage or defect feature information using the principal component analysis method, and the wavelet threshold denoising, improved threshold denoising and other processing, and perform threshold segmentation on infrared images to obtain defect characteristic information, indicating that infrared thermal imaging can be used to detect 4 mm and above delamination defects inside carbon fiber composite laminates, and the detection effect can meet the defect determination requirements.

articleTitle: Distributed Temperature Monitoring System for Auto Spontaneous Combustion Based on Multiple Sensor Signals
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Because the pressure and the temperature exceed the safety standard scope, causes the automobile performance to reduce greatly, finally causes the automobile self-ignition accident. In order to prevent and reduce the probability of this kind of accident, a temperature monitoring system is designed by using multiplex sensor signal and STM32 controller to monitor the temperature in real time. The SP37 sensor integrates pressure sensor and temperature sensor, and its internal controller is compatible with 8051 instruction. It also has the function of RF transmission. The system displays the temperature data in real time. When the data exceed the safety threshold, the system sends out warning sound to warn the driver to prevent the danger of spontaneous combustion. Experimental results show that the design has the advantages of good stability, high measurement accuracy and low power consumption.

articleTitle: Simulated experiments of rotor-stator interaction rubbing and sand ingestion fault based on aero-engine electrostatic sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: A new test rig has been established to simulate rotor-stator interaction rubbing and sand ingestion fault based on aero-engine electrostatic sensor. The experimental results show that the greater the fore in rubbing interaction, the larger the charge amount of rubbing particles and the higher the heat carried by rubbing particles. The frequency domain analysis shows that the rotation frequency of rotor can be reflected clearly in the spectrum of rubbing particles’ electrostatic signal, which can be the indicator to distinguish rubbing particles and sand particles. The results are beneficial to the implementation of prognostics and health management in aero-engine based on electrostatic monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on Passive RFID Tag Antenna Sensor for Metal Structure Strain Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The long-term load bearing of metal structures will cause the deformation of the structure. Considering that the traditional methods of detecting the deformation of metal structures are mostly manual observation, this method has many shortcomings, such as information lag and inaccurate detection. In response to the above problems, a method of using the relative position of the tag antenna to characterize the change in the shape of the metal object is studied, the corresponding tag antenna sensor is designed, and a common commercial RFID reader is used to detect the actual effect. Experiments have proved that the tag antenna can be used to characterize the shape change of the metal object structure in the horizontal direction. The experimental data show that the detection accuracy can reach the centimeter level.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Design of Shot Blasting Machine Blade Based on Modal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The blade of shot blasting machine is taken as the research object. ABAQUS finite element software is used to analyze the blade modal of semi cylindrical end face and rectangular end face, analyze the blade failure causes from the angle of resonance and stress, and compare the data. The results show that there is no resonance between the two kinds of blades and the motor at rated power, there is stress concentration between the semi cylindrical blade and the center wheel, and the rectangular blade can reduce the stress concentration, which has reference significance for improving the reliability and prolonging the service life of the shot blasting machine.

articleTitle: Magneto-Optical Imaging Feature Extraction of Angle Welding Defects Based on Polarization Information
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In order to improve the effective data quantity of corner weld defect magneto-optical imaging feature extraction, a method based on polarization information is proposed. The magneto-optical imaging principle of corner welding defects is analyzed, and the magneto-optical image of defects is collected. Based on this, the MOO image is preprocessed by smoothing filter, image enhancement, background removal and specular highlights respectively, and the result of feature extraction is obtained. Compared with the traditional feature extraction method, the effective data volume of the design feature extraction method is improved by 19.535MB.

articleTitle: A whole life cycle maintenance strategy of civil aircraft precooler based on case-based reasoning and probability model
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This method studies the maintenance strategy of civil aircraft precooler in the whole life cycle, and provides technical support for civil aircraft operation. Firstly, the performance recovery model of aircraft precooler is established based on case-based reasoning. Then, the life cycle failure probability model of precooler is established based on Weibull model under the condition of small samples, and a certain aircraft model is taken as the verification object. The results show that in order to reduce the operation cost, it is the best time to arrange the performance recovery task of the precooler to the aircraft C-check. At the same time, the replacement of the precooler during the D-check can effectively reduce the number of AOG(Aircraft On Ground) in the whole life cycle.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent detection method of ancient building damage characteristics in deep learning environment
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In view of the problem that the strength value of damage features obtained by existing intelligent feature detection methods is too small, which leads to poor coupling between building damage features, this paper designs an intelligent detection method of ancient building damage features in deep learning environment. After the long-term load numerical model of ancient buildings is constructed by using deep learning technology, the damage characteristics of bearing columns of ancient buildings are calibrated and processed into a distance term and an angle term, and the intelligent detection numerical relationship of damage characteristics is constructed. According to the ancient building damage feature extraction results, the GNSS coordinates of damage points are collected, and the detection methods based on low-level topology, damage mechanism and the designed detection methods are used for experiments. The experimental results show that the designed intelligent detection method has the largest value of damage feature strength, the best coupling between damage feature indexes, and the practical application effect is good.

articleTitle: A B-Spline Based Gaussian Process Regression Approach for Fatigue Crack Length Estimation Using Ultrasonic Wave Data
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The diagnosis and prognosis of fatigue cracks, which greatly influence the long-term durability of structures, is an important issue for structural health monitoring (SHM). This paper presents a study on the estimation of fatigue crack length using ultrasonic wave data. The measured signal is first denoised and truncated to extract the informative period of the signal. If a crack is detected, features are extracted to represent the distortion of the signals while reducing the influence of noise with a B-spline based method. Gaussian process regression obtained from an integration of mean and covariance functions is used for the estimation of the crack length. Real-world experiments validates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Sub-array Digital Phased Array Testing Method
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The sub-array digital phased array radar is a hybrid mode of analog array and digital array. Reasonable process design can improve testing efficiency and accuracy. This paper studied the test method and process of the sub-array digital phased array, including channel troubleshooting, midfield and near field calibration, midfield lobe detection and near field lobe pattern test of array. The application of full-cycle test procedure verifies the sub-array digital phased array antenna test method, and provides support for the testing technology development of this antenna architecture.

articleTitle: NSP-CNN Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The vibration signal of rolling bearing has non-stationary and nonlinear characteristics. In order to apply the advantages of deep learning recognition of 2-D images to the fault diagnosis of rolling bearings, a multi-layer nested scatter plot-convolutional neural network (NSP-CNN) rolling bearing fault diagnosis model is proposed. The model uses fast Fourier transform to obtain the frequency spectrum of the vibration signal in different directions, and divides the frequency bands. After that, the signals of different bandwidths are given different colors to highlight the fault information of the rolling bearing. Finally, the combined NSP The optimized CNN model is input to the feature map to realize fault diagnosis. The results show that the model can achieve high diagnostic accuracy when diagnosing rolling bearing faults.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Effects of Wear and Clearance in a 3D Revolute Joint
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper presents an experimental study on the effects of wear and clearance in a 3D revolute joint. Digital image correlation measurement is applied to obtain linkages’ motion information. A cylindricity test is carried out to measure the contour data in contact regions. Dynamic and wear behaviors of the four-bar mechanism with different bearing sizes are studied. Results show that clearance in 3D revolute joint significantly decreases system’s dynamic performance. The wear distribution on the bearing’s inner surface is non-uniform in both radial and axial directions. The maximum wear depth area locates at the bearing’s edges.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Health State Assessment for Complex equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Health assessment is of great significance to realize the active maintenance of complex equipment and effectively avoid accidents. But how to extract fault information from data with correlation and redundancy is the key of health status assessment. In order to accurately assess the status of oil drilling pump, this paper proposed a health status assessment method based on Softmax and Mahalanobis Distance(MD). Firstly, the time-frequency characteristics of the vibration signal of oil drilling pump were extracted; Then, the improved LTSA was used to reduce the dimension of the extracted features; Finally, the Softmax classifier was trained to recognize the state of the low dimensional feature sequence, and the Mahalanobis distance between the output sequence and the ideal health state sequence was calculated to further construct the health index to evaluate the health state of the oil drilling pump. The results show that this method can effectively and accurately evaluate the health status of complex systems.

articleTitle: Integrated System Health Management Research and Application on Satellite
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Integrated system health management (ISHM) technology is the extension of fault diagnosis and fault tolerant control and also is an important research direction of satellite engineering in the future. The ISHM of satellite, which can support satellite self-sufficient, aims to improve the reliability, safety and economy. In this paper, the overall architecture of the ISHM of on-orbit satellite is firstly constructed, which is divided into several layers, including system-level layer, subsystem layer, reasoning and diagnosis layer and single machine layer. The functions and tasks of each layer are analyzed, and the differences between ISHM and traditional fault diagnosis methods are proposed. Secondly, according to the analysis of history fault data, the subsystems who are prone to fault are studied and the ISHM schemes for these subsystems are designed. Finally, key technologies for achieving ISHM of satellite, such as the use of advanced distributed sensor system, improvement of software and hardware on board, and the application of intelligent algorithms, are illustrated and discussed.

articleTitle: Failure Analysis of Electromagnetic-Pneumatic Valve in Bogie-Based Braking Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: As one of the key actuators of the train braking system, the safety and reliability of the Electromagnetic-Pneumatic (EP) valve has been received extensive attention. First, this paper introduces the specific structure and working principle of the EP valve in the train bogie-based braking control system. Then, a mathematical analytical model of the electromagnetic valve in the EP valve was established by using Matlab/Simulink. Besides, the functional structure model of the pneumatic valve in the EP valve was established by using AMEsim software. Finally, the output response characteristics of electromagnetic valves and pneumatic valves under common failure modes are simulated through fault simulation, which reveals the failure mechanism of EP valve and provides a theoretical basis for subsequent fault diagnosis research.

articleTitle: Test Design of Small Sample Launch Vehicle Based on Composite Equivalency Bayesian Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In view of the high development cost of the Long March series of launch vehicle and the difficulty of implementing reliability tests, a small sample reliability sampling method based on composite equivalency Bayesian fusion is proposed. First, in order to avoid large amounts of prior data submerging the field data with small sample, a comprehensive use of physical equivalency credibility and data compatibility test are used to fully integrate multi-source test data. Then, according to Bayesian theory, the reliability of the fusion data of the launch vehicle that obeys the normal distribution is statistically verified under the complex assumptions. Finally, considering the experimental cost and the constraints of the two types of risks, a nonlinear constraint programming model for solving the minimum sample size is established.

articleTitle: A prediction method of LEO satellite orbit control effect based on multiple regression analysis model
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper combined regular characteristic of a LEO satellite orbit control to construct a quantity prediction model for orbit control with correlation analysis of feature parameters in abundant data. And a prediction method of LEO satellite orbit control effect based on multiple regression analysis model was proposed, which had been verified effectively in the actual orbit control. This method could be used as an auxiliary technique to evaluate the traditional orbit control effect for LEO satellite.

articleTitle: A Method Using Quantum Genetic Algorithm optimized BP Neural Network of Real-time Fault Detection for the Liquid Rocket Engine
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: As an essential part of modern launch vehicles, liquid rocket engines have attracted more and more attention for their safe operation and reusable capability. Aiming at the real-time fault detection requirements of liquid rocket engines, this article proposes a real-time fault detection method for liquid rocket engines using quantum genetic algorithm optimizing BP neural network. First, use quantum genetic algorithm to optimize the BP neural network to obtain the QGABP model, and then use the model to predict the sensor value. After that, the threshold is used to judge whether the engine is faulty. According to the comparison and simulation results through different models, this method accelerates the convergence speed, can converge to the global optimal solution faster, realize the real-time fault detection of liquid rocket engines, and has engineering application merits.

articleTitle: Contact Degradation Mechanism and Test Study of Electrical Connector under Micropore Corrosion
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Electrical connectors are widely used in various types of shipboard equipment, in the marine salt spray environment, corrosion, especially micropore corrosion of electrical connector pins is an important degradation mode of electrical connectors, and the mechanism is complex. To address this problem, we analyzed the corrosion degradation mechanism of electrical connectors in salt spray environment, established a micropore corrosion model for different locations of electrical connector pin plating layer, analyzed the mechanism of corrosion stress on the static contact resistance of electrical connectors in the plugged state from a microscopic point of view, and finally carried out salt spray corrosion tests on electrical connectors to verily the correctness of the micropore corrosion model of electrical connectors under micropore corrosion conditions and the correctness of its contact degradation mechanism.

articleTitle: Double Layer Feature Selection and Feature Fusion Method for Rolling Bearing Based on AFF-AAKR
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: As the basic part of mechanical equipment, rolling bearing plays an important role in rotating machinery. Therefore, condition monitoring and remaining useful life (RUL) prediction of rolling bearings are particularly important in industrial production. Accurate feature extraction and efficient feature fusion are the two key steps of traditional data-driven RUL prediction method. This paper proposes a double layer feature selection method. Primary screening of features is to select the sensitive subset which is sensitive to the degradation trend through the comprehensive index sorting. Re-selection of features based on hierarchical clustering and mutual information can further eliminate redundant features from sensitive feature subset, and finally get the optimal subset. Then a feature-based fusion method based on adaptive feature fusion method (AFF) and auto association kernel regression model (AAKR) is proposed to construct health indicator which can reflect the degradation trend of rolling bears.

articleTitle: Study on Vibration of the Anisotropically Rotor System with Different Sections Based on the Improved Riccati Transfer Matrix Method
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The vibration problem of the high-pressure rotor system with different sections and the elastic ring squeeze film damper is the research topic of this paper. Firstly, the equivalent stiffness and damping of the oil film of ERSFD are obtained by using the finite-difference theory. By improving the Riccati transfer matrix method, the transfer matrix and the response equation are established about the disk-shaft and the conical structures. The oil clearance and eccentricity during the motion of the elastic ring from the suspension to the inner and outer bosses contact are discussed. The unbalance values of the disk is concerned too. The vibration response of each node is analyzed. The reasonable region of relevant parameters is given. The obtained results provide a basis for the dynamic design of the complex rotor system.

articleTitle: Power Spectral Entropy-based Graph Construction for Rotating Machinery Diagnosis Using Multi-sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Multi-sensor fusion-based methods have achieved great results in rotating machinery fault diagnosis. However, many of them fail in mining the relationship between signals during the fusion process, leading to the loss of information. Graph convolutional network (GCN) can effectively mine the relationship between nodes hidden in the geometric structure, which can further improve the performance of multi-sensor fusion-based methods. Therefore, a power spectral entropy-based graph construction for rotating machinery diagnosis using multi-sensor is proposed. Power spectral entropy is extracted from multiple sensors using wavelet packet decomposition. Then, a fused feature is constructed by combing them. On the basis, the power spectral entropy-based graph is obtained by a distance-based clustering algorithm using the fused feature. Finally, graph feature learning with GCN is used to extract fault features. Verification experiments were conducted on a gearbox experimental platform, and results show that the proposed method can effectively classify faults.

articleTitle: Research on Cascading Effect Analysis of Civil Aircraft Shared Data and Resource System Failures
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Failures of shared data and resource system have now become a key concern in civil aircraft development process during recent years, especially considering the increase of the complexity and integration level of aircraft systems. Cascading and cumulative effect of these kind of failures needs to be investigated very well to ensure aircraft safety, for the reason that common systems always have lots of interfaces with other systems, and failures can propagate significantly due to the dependency of airborne systems. Considering current safety analysis approaches such as Failure Mode Effect Analysis (FMEA) and Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) are more applicable for federated systems architecture, this thesis presents a systematic way to Figure out all the direct or indirect effects caused by the shared data and resource system failures. A logic and iterative process, illustration of each steps, the synthetic evaluation and verification means are studied. Research contents and relevant practice provided in this thesis can be an important supplement to the safety process and airworthiness certification of civil aircraft development.

articleTitle: Research on Maintainability Verification Technology of Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper studies the development stage of civil aircraft maintainability verification work, studies the object and method of civil aircraft maintainability verification, explains the management requirements of maintainability verification data, and puts forward the evaluation criteria of maintainability verification. The maintainability verification process and results of some important equipment of civil aircraft show that the technology system has strong operability. At the same time, the application of virtual maintenance verification technology can provide more help for engineering practice.

articleTitle: Optimization of Axial Contact Stiffness of Precision Ball Screws Based on Hertzian Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The maximum axial contact stiffness optimization model of double-nut ball screws was established. The coupling association of the normal force of raceway with the variation of the contact angle based on Hertzian theory was considered. The optimal axial contact stiffness can be determined by using ISIGHT integrated MATLAB with the NLPQL (quadratic sequence planning method) method in terms of the contact angle and curvature ratio. The results showed that within a specified range with a gradually increasing curvature ratio, the contact angle increased, whereas ball screw axial contact stiffness first increased and then decreased. The axial contact stiffness was increased by 13.3% after optimization.

articleTitle: Application of Denoising Autoencoder in Intelligent Fault Diagnosis for Bearings under Varying Working Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
