abstract: Bearing fault diagnosis is an important issue and useful tool to keep the equipment safe and reliable. With sustainable progress of deep learning and the use of large-scale industrial data, intelligent fault diagnosis based on the deep learning has become one of main research directions in this field. To improve the practicability of results, the denoising autoencoder (DAE) is applied to the bearings with complex working conditions. Two experiments are conducted to compare the performances of the DAE and the stack autoencoder (SAE). In the experiments, the data from one rotation speed are used for training, and the data from different conditions, including the changes of the rotation speed, load torque, and radial force, are used for test. The results indicate that only the rotation speed may influence the classification accuracy, and its changes may lead to the misclassification of bearing health states. For the changes of the other two conditions, the DAE and SAE have high diagnosis accuracies, and the former shows better results.

articleTitle: Airworthiness Certification of IMA-based OMS on Transport Category Airplane
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The Onboard Maintenance System (OMS) is key system to implement the Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) technology in the transport category airplane. Integrated Modular Avionics (IMA) and Avionics Full Duplex Switched Ethernet (AFDX) with the faster data exchange is utilized in the newly developed aircraft. This paper briefly introduces the system function and architecture of IMA-based OMS. The airworthiness certification requirement of Part 25 and Special Condition are systemically analyzed. The approaches and some key technology concerns of airworthiness certification for IMA-based OMS installed on transport category airplane are discussed in detail, which can be used as reference for aviation industry to achieve the airworthiness certification.

articleTitle: Visibility Graph based Feature Extraction for Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In the vibration signal of rolling bearing, there are correlations between different frequency components, which is an important information for rolling bearing fault diagnosis. In this paper, in order to extract the correlation information effectively, visibility graph based feature extraction is introduced. Firstly, power spectrum is extracted by the welch method, therefore the signal is converted into frequency domain. Then, through the visibility graph (VG) modeling of power spectrum, correlation information between frequency components is obtained. After that, eight representative features will be extracted from VG, i.e., edge numbers, link density, average closeness centrality, average degree, graph entropy, average distribution weight, weight entropy, and clustering coefficient. Finally, the fault types are diagnosed by one-versus-one support vector machines (OVOSVMs). Compared with the existing fault diagnosis methods, it is proved that the proposed method can diagnose the faults of rolling bearing effectively.

articleTitle: Stiffness Analysis of High-speed Cylindrical Roller Bearing Subjected to Combined Loads
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper presents an analytical investigation of the stiffness on high-speed cylindrical roller bearings which are subjected to various compound loads. A four degree-of-freedom quasi-static model is established to study the stiffness matrix of the high-speed cylindrical roller bearings. Then, a systematical research to thoroughly investigate the effect of rotating speed and external load on the stiffness for cylindrical roller bearing is presented. Moreover, the influences of the basic bearing structural parameters including roller profile and the number of rollers on the bearing stiffness matrix are also given.

articleTitle: Online teaching system of Japanese translation course based on P2P network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: in order to further improve the quality of Japanese teaching, this paper puts forward a design method of online teaching system of Japanese translation course based on P2P network, mainly for the detailed design of the system hardware structure framework and system function module, and optimizes the software module function and operation steps, on this basis, the system test is carried out. Through the implementation of the system, the stability and effectiveness of the online teaching system of Japanese translation course based on P2P network is good, which can significantly improve the teaching efficiency and students' Japanese learning effect, and is worthy of promotion and application.

articleTitle: Gyro anomaly detection method based on information entropy
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: As the gyroscope serves as the main measurement component in most satellite control subsystems, its working state directly affects the safe operation of satellites in orbit. In engineering field, the common fault detection methods consist of the balance equation method and the threshold current method. Among which, the balance equation method is mainly utilized to detect the residual error of the output of gyroscope and to isolate the fault after the abnormality occurs. However, it poses a strict restriction on the number of gyroscope in normal operation. However, the current threshold method takes the simple gyro motor current threshold as a means to detect the fault, therefore does not involve the information before the current exceeds the limit. The aim of this paper is to combine the information contained in the deviation and stability of motor current change before gyro fault, utilize the method of information entropy to detect the current variation data before gyro fault. The test results verifies that this method can detect the abnormal state of gyroscope before the other two methods, and thus can be used as one of the effective means to detect the abnormal state of gyroscope.

articleTitle: Low-speed energy feedback braking method for motor system of rod pumping equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper focuses on the principle of electromagnetic braking and energy feedback when the motor speed is lower than a certain speed of no-load motor, and puts forward a simple control method of low-speed energy feedback braking. Through computer simulation and prototype experiment, it can be seen that the control method proposed in this paper can easily achieve the low-speed energy feedback braking effect of the electric vehicle water magnetic brushless direct charging motor system, and ensure the safety of vehicle driving.

articleTitle: Trilateration Based on the Combination and K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Trilateration is a classic positioning algorithm that uses the coordinates of three reference nodes to obtain the coordinate of an unknown node. It is widely used in various positioning algorithms because of its simple principle and low computational complexity. But when the three circles do not intersect at one point, a significant positioning error may occur. This paper proposes a new trilateration positioning algorithm based on the combination and K-Means clustering. The proposed algorithm can make full use of the position information and distance information of the reference nodes in the area. It can effectively remove the points with significant errors through K-Means clustering. Simulation experiments prove that this method can effectively improve the accuracy of positioning.

articleTitle: Neural networks based immune recognition model for aeroengine coupled rotor system fault detection
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Aeroengine is a high-speed coupled dual-rotor mechanical system. Some of its abnormal vibration phenomena cannot be explained by linear theory. Therefore, the study on how to detect its fault is of great worth. In this paper, a neural network detector is constructed based on the principle of immune recognition, and the abnormal characteristics of engine rotor vibration signal are captured by the detector. The abnormal vibration signal features are trained and stored in the detector. If the signal samples to be detected match what have been stored in the detector, the exact fault will be found. The vibration experiments show that this method has high sensitivity for the detection of coupled dual-rotor system, and can effectively identify the common faults of aero-engine rotor system.

articleTitle: The Abnormal Detection Strategy for Spacecraft Components with Multi-dimension Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Aiming at realizing the abnormal detection for spacecraft components based on the monitoring during environmental testing, this paper proposes a novel strategy containing principal component analysis (PCA), one class support vector machine (OCSVM), and integrated learning. Firstly, product features are extracted from the raw data. Then, PCA is utilized to reduce the feature dimension and standardize the data. After that, sub-datasets are generated through resampling and utilized to train the individual OCSVM models. Finally, the decision results of these models are averaged to obtain the final classification results. A case study based on a thruster simulation dataset shows that the proposed strategy can obtain accurate detection results.

articleTitle: An End-to-end Fault Diagnosis Method of Rolling Bearing Based on Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Rolling bearing is an important part of industrial machinery, and it’s vital to diagnose what the bearing’s defect is when it fails. With the help of deep learning, the deep neural network can be used to diagnose kinds of faults with automatic diagnosis. However, the neural network can’t identify the faults by using raw vibration data. This paper proposes a novel fault diagnosis method of rolling bearing that using the frequency data as the input of the improved convolution neural network model, where the frequency data is transformed from fast Fourier transform. No manual experience is required in this method. Experiment verification is tested on the two datasets, CRWU dataset and DLUT dataset. And the experiment results show the superiority of the suggested technique which realizes the end-to-end diagnostic method on rolling bearing.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis of Engine Bolt Tightening Based on One-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Threaded connection is one of the most widely used connection methods in automobile manufacturing industry. The quality of thread connection is directly related to the life safety. With the development of tightening technology and the improvement of tightening equipment manufacturing level. As a method to record the dynamic changes of tightening process, tightening curve technology has been relatively mature. However, it is extremely difficult to identify the failure of tightening process in real time with human experience. In this paper, an intelligent fault diagnosis method based on one-dimensional convolutional neural network (ID-CNN) is proposed, which can effectively reduce the false positive and false negative caused by manual recognition. Experimental results show that the fault diagnosis accuracy is over 98%.

articleTitle: Belief Reliability Analysis of Electrical Performance Based on Analog Behavior Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: When calculating the belief reliability of electronic products, it is often used to establish a circuit simulation model to perform Monte Carlo analysis to obtain the key performance degradation parameters of the product. In this process, the lack of electronic component models is often a major difficulty that restricts this method. This article introduces the analog behavioral model (ABM) modeling method of electronic products, and gives the modeling process for power converters and relays, and substitutes the established model into a certain type of control circuit for transient simulation. Verity the usability of the model. Then use Monte Carlo simulation in circuit simulation to obtain key performance simulation results in the circuit. Finally, the belief reliability of the control circuit is calculated based on the principles of the four equations for the reliability.

articleTitle: Design and Dynamic Analysis of Random Vibration Test Fixture for Aerospace Valve
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The aerospace valve is an important part of the rocket system, and its working state is greatly affected by random vibration. In the ground environment vibration test, how to design a high performance fixture to make the valve and the vibration table connected closely and transmit the complete vibration load is very important. This paper uses the combination of T-shaped fixture and threaded connection to design a fixture that can undertake valve environmental vibration test, and conduct dynamic analysis. Through modal analysis, the natural frequency and vibration mode of the fixture system are obtained, and the key position is obtained through random response analysis. The output response is judged whether it meets the requirements of transmitting a complete vibration load. Because the fixture bolt layout has a great impact on the performance, three groups of dynamic analysis were carried out by changing the bolt spacing to compare the results, and the impact of the bolt layout on the fixture was analyzed.

articleTitle: An Analytical Representation Method for Dynamic Behavior of Rotating Blade with Transverse Crack
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Blade crack monitoring is of great significance for ensuring the operational safety of aero-engine. An effective dynamic modeling method of the crack for rotating blade is a significant challenge faced by aero-engine blade crack monitoring. Aiming at the analytical vibration modeling of the rotating blade crack for aero-engines, a criterion for judging the stress state of the blade crack cross-section was constructed on the basis of the in-depth mechanism analysis of the breathing effect for blade cracks. A high-fidelity dynamic model of blade crack was proposed based on the stress state at the blade crack cross-section. By comparing with the finite element model, the model’s validity is demonstrated; by comparing with the conventional models, the model proposed in this paper is confirmed to have higher accuracy. It can provide a high-fidelity analytical model for the fault mechanism analysis of rotating blade crack.

articleTitle: Reliability test and evaluation of Satellite battery bypass based on stress relaxation
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: According to the characteristics of satellite lithium ion battery bypass switch application, the stress relaxation theory of compression spring is applied to By-Pass reliability test design and reliability evaluation. Aiming at the requirement of By-Pass reliability evaluation data, reliability test equipment was designed to quantity the discreteness of the product itself to the greatest extent. According to the reliability test, the reliability evaluation method of the compression spring based on stress relaxation is given. Based on the compression spring test data, the reliability of the non-operation failure when the By-Pass is triggered is evaluated.

articleTitle: Wavelet Entropy Applied in gearbox fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The vibration signal of the gearbox usually has non-stationary and non-linear characteristics, including quite weak fault signals. Therefore, the feature extraction of faulty gearboxes is usually very difficult, which has attracted the attention of many scholars. In this article, a gearbox fault diagnosis method based on wavelet entropy and information fusion is proposed. This paper extracts four different wavelet entropy fault features and calculates wavelet root mean square (RMS) entropy, wavelet crest factor (PF) entropy, wavelet singularity (WS) entropy, and wavelet time-frequency (WTF) entropy. In this wavelet entropy, wavelet RMS entropy and wavelet PF entropy can be classified as wavelet time-domain feature entropy. In this way, a fault feature vector containing four elements can be obtained. As an innovation of this article, principal component analysis (PCA) is used to fuse these wavelet entropies. Through orthogonal transformation, the fault feature vector can be got under the new coordinates. This paper the first three components is chose as the final fault feature vector. Another innovation of this article is the feature parameter part. In this article, the matrix norm is calculated as the feature to be extracted, which is an innovation in fault diagnosis. Finally, this paper conducted two case studies on this method. In case study 1, this paper uses single failure mode gearbox failure data to validate the method. Experimental results show that PCA-based information fusion has a great contribution to feature extraction. In practice, gearbox failures usually include mixed failure modes. Therefore, in order to verity the fault diagnosis ability of this method in practice, this paper uses the mixed failure mode gearbox fault data to test the method in case study 2. The test results show that the method based on wavelet entropy and information fusion has good diagnostic performance. Practice of gearbox fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Risk Assessment Method for Construction Safety of Fabricated Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: For the construction safety risk assessment of prefabricated construction projects, the traditional evaluation methods are difficult to ensure the data quality under dynamic changes, which affects the reliability of the evaluation results. Therefore, this paper puts forward the research on the dynamic evaluation method of construction safety risk of prefabricated building engineering. According to the construction environment of the assembly construction project, the risk source is determined by analytic hierarchy process, the evaluation index is selected, and the weight vector of each index is calculated. After the one-time assessment, the variable weight of the weight vector is processed according to the characteristics of dynamic change, the comprehensive weight of the evaluation object is calculated, the evaluation standard cloud is constructed, the comprehensive weight is substituted into the evaluation standard cloud, and the dynamic evaluation of construction safety risk is realized in combination with the evaluation language. The experimental results show that the designed evaluation method has high data quality and can effectively evaluate the construction safety risk of prefabricated construction projects.

articleTitle: Nonlinear feature extraction method of pitch control signal in Erhu works based on graph convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Feature integration refers to the process of integrating feature vectors in a short time window into a new single feature vector in a long time window. The intonation of erhu works is a long-term temporal feature. At present, the mean and variance are often used to obtain the long-term characteristics of intonation in erhu works to maintain the temporal characteristics of timbre. On the basis of graph convolutional neural network, the non-linear feature extraction method of intonation control signal in erhu works is studied. Using the smallest unit note of music as the processing unit, a dynamic multivariable automatic regression model feature is proposed, which realizes the timing feature of timbre Integration. This feature vector is applied to the timbre recognition of musical instruments. At the same time, in the post-processing of the intonation recognition in the Erhu works, the method of calculating the probability of the weighted average is used to determine the category of the music, which has greatly improved.

articleTitle: UAV Actuator Fault Detection using Maximal Information Coefficient and 1-D Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Actuator is a critical part of the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), for which accurate and speedy fault detection is of great significance in practical application. Data-driven method becomes more appealing due to its feasibility and high performance. However, the current fault detection method based on machine learning cannot realize feature selection and real-time detection, and its feature extraction and learning ability of time series is not high enough. To solve the above problems, we propose a new fault detection method based on maximal information coefficient and one dimensional convolutional neural network (MIC-1DCNN) approach. It combines the high feature extraction ability of one dimensional convolutional neural network (1DCNN) for time series and the good feature selection ability of maximal information coefficient (MIC) for nonlinear data, which complete UAV actuator fault detection well and improve its efficiency greatly. The benchmark flight data set of the UAV is adopted for conducting experimental verification. The experimental results indicate that the proposed method can achieve satisfied performance in UAV actuator fault detection regarding speed and accuracy indices.

articleTitle: Application of Reliability Technology in Railway System
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In order to understand the application of reliability technology in the railway system, the application situation in several subsystems such as the power distribution system, power automation system, traction power supply system, dispatching and command system of the railway system is analyzed, and the above subsystems are summarized. The new progress and development law of the application of reliability technology in the middle of the world, and the possible development trend of the application of reliability technology in the railway system is prospected.

articleTitle: Industrial fault diagnosis based on few shot learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In fault diagnosis, traditional machine learning methods usually require manual feature selection, which requires higher professional background and multiple attempts. Although deep learning avoids the selection of features, it needs a large amount of data. In industrial systems, it is usually difficult and expensive to obtain fault data, so it is not suitable for the fault diagnosis task with few data. In this paper, we use the idea of Few Shot Learning for fault diagnosis to avoid the difficulty of manual feature selection, and it is suitable for the fault diagnosis field with few samples. For the fault tasks to be diagnosed, this paper uses additional data to obtain prior knowledge. On the basis of the prototype network, we use one-dimensional convolutional neural network to extract the signal features of the fault signals, and complete the final classification with KNN. In order to alleviate the problem of few samples size, we also introduced the method of data enhancement to improve the fault diagnosis rate to a certain extent. The experimental results show that in the case of few samples, proposed few shot learning fault diagnosis method in this paper obtains good diagnosis results.

articleTitle: Type-I Censored Reliability Acceptance Plan for Exponentially Distributed Products by Fusing Different Types of Information
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The reliability acceptance test (RAT) is to check whether the product meets the reliability requirement. It is important that the customer’s risk and the producer’s risk of the test plan controllable. The RAT plan in GJB899A is hard to be applicated because the test duration is too long and the risks uncontrollable. In order to optimize the RAT, a method to design the Type-I censored plans by fusing different types of information is proposed. The D-S based method is applicated and the two types of risk can be determined more accurately by fusing the expert knowledge. Then the Type-I censored RAT can be further derived. In the end, the case study shows that the proposed method is better than the method in GJB899A.

articleTitle: Failure Analysis for Pressure Fluctuation of Oxygen Phase-change Heat Exchanger in Rocket Engine
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Pressure fluctuation occurred in the inlet and outlet of the helically coiled phase-change heat exchanger in the rocket engine during the ground test and it would result in failure during the flight mission. Failure analysis was conducted by flow and heat simulation for the oxygen flow in the phase-change heat exchanger based on the distributed parameter model (DPM) to explore the mechanism of the pressure fluctuation. The thermal parameters including pressure and temperature along the flow tube is calculated by the use of the local physical properties and the local heat transfer & friction coefficients. It can be concluded by the contrast of the oxygen’s thermal process that the pressure fluctuation is caused by the low vaporization pressure. When the vaporization pressure is close to the critical pressure, the intense physical properties fluctuations due to the extremely high thermal expansion coefficient results in the flow instability which causes the pressure fluctuation.

articleTitle: Anonymous access control model of mobile RFID system in Internet of things
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Aiming at the access control of tag privacy information and the protection of user identity privacy in mobile RFID system of Internet of things, the anonymous access control model of mobile RFID system of Internet of things is designed by combining identity encryption and attribute encryption. The anonymous access control security model is established, and the identity and attribute based authenticated key exchange protocol ib-ab-ake is designed. This paper proposes an authentication key exchange protocol between mobile RFID system and information server, while protecting the user identity privacy of mobile RFID system, the access control authentication and session key exchange of tag information are carried out according to the access control policy customized by the tag owner, to prevent illegal access to privacy information. Experimental results show that ib-ab-ake protocol is secure in the anonymous access control model, and has advantages in communication times, traffic, and computation.

articleTitle: Research on reliability evaluation method of fan-out package based on sub-model
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: As a kind of advanced packaging, fan-out package has great advantages in 5G and intelligent wearable fields because of its small package size, short interconnection and high performance. It is also considered as one of the means to achieve beyond Moore’s law. Compared with traditional packaging devices, fan-out packaging devices have more complex and refined internal structure. Using traditional finite element analysis method for modeling and analysis can not obtain more accurate simulation results, and it takes a long time. Therefore, a reliability evaluation method of fan-out package based on sub-model method is studied in this paper. Firstly, COMSOL Multiphysics is used to build the main-model of the fan-out packaging device, and the dangerous solder joint position of the device is analyzed. Secondly, the whole field displacement of the fan-out packaging device after heating is measured by digital image correlation technology, and the main-model is verified. Thirdly, the sub-model of dangerous solder joint is established, and the accurate simulation results are obtained. Finally, based on the sub-model simulation results, the thermal fatigue life of typical fan out packaging devices is given by Darveaux model.

articleTitle: A mission-oriented shipboard spare parts allowance method using reliability simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: A simulation method for calculating the quantity of spare parts carried in the ship which performs a mission is proposed. This method evaluates the impact of the related equipment failure on the overall mission reliability of ship after the increase of each spare part, predicts the requirements of the spare parts, and optimizes the shipboard spare parts allowance scheme with the purpose of optimizing the availability or mission reliability of the ship during the mission. And this method improves the execution efficiency of the simulation optimization method. Particularly, it is suitable for the large-scale system as ship with such a large number of spare parts and complex task execution process.

articleTitle: A Network Structure Search Method Based on Reinforcement Learning for Rolling Bearing Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Accurate fault diagnosis is very important to the operation and maintenance of rotating machinery. Therefore, a neural network structure search method is proposed for rolling bearing fault diagnosis. Firstly, the child model is constructed by convolutional neural network (CNN) and the search space of child model is preset. Secondly, the controller is constructed by the recurrent neural network (RNN), the current state and reward of the child model are taken as inputs to generate the selected child model structure. Finally, reinforcement learning method is used to update the controller until the optimal child model is selected. The proposed method is used to the rolling bearing of electric locomotive. The experimental result shows the optimal child model selected in this paper is superior to other child model structures and some mainstream deep learning models. This method can successfully achieve the automatic search for neural network structure based on the given dataset.

articleTitle: Research on hot news information discovery and development trend prediction based on decision tree
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Traditional methods have the problems of low detection accuracy and high recall rate when searching hot news information. Therefore, this paper designs a hot news information discovery and development trend prediction method based on decision tree. On the basis of calculating the weight of user attention parameters, the interference information of user attention parameters is eliminated by decision tree algorithm, and then the data set of user attention parameters is established. Based on this, the feature of news text is extracted as topic vector, and the media attention of news information is calculated. Combined with user attention and media attention, the hot index of news information is calculated. The news with a high hot index is regarded as the discovered hot information, and the news with a fast hot index growth rate is regarded as the predicted hot information. Experimental results show that this method improves the accuracy of news information detection and reduces the recall rate of news information detection.

articleTitle: Product Key Reliability Characteristics Identification Approach Using GA in Manufacturing Process
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The manufacturing process is the last kilometer and dam of product reliability from the design process to the operational process. It is important to identify the key reliability characteristic (KRC) of the products and control the reliability of the products in the manufacturing process proactively. Thus, in order to improve product reliability and mitigate reliability degradation in manufacturing process, a novel product KRCs identification approach based on genetic algorithm (GA) is proposed. Firstly, based on the Stream of Variation theory (SOV) and the RQR chain, the mechanism of reliability formation in manufacturing stage is expounded, and the causes of the product reliability degradation in the manufacturing process is analyzed. Secondly, the definition of KRC is proposed, and a KRCs identification model based on GA is established. Thirdly, an approach to identify KRCs by GA is proposed. Finally, an illustrated example of a subway insulation seat is provided to verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on a Reliability Prediction Method Based on Fuzzy Cognitive Map
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Generally in a method on reliability prediction for a system, there is an assumption that the process of each component failure is independent, irrelevant and not affected by other components. However, in the actual working process of a product, the life change caused by dynamic influences among the components of the product should not be negligible. In this paper, a method on reliability prediction based on fuzzy cognitive map is proposed, and a case study using system in package (SiP) is given to determine the life of each component of the SiP under the state of dynamic mutual influences.

articleTitle: Research on Statics Model of Aircraft Fuel Tank Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In order to solve the difficulties faced by aircraft fuel tank failure inspection, this paper designs a multi-backbones continuous robot based on a push-pull structure. In order to explain the deformation characteristics of the robot from a mechanical point of view, the Newton-Euler method is used to determine the tension of the robot’s flexible backbones, the gravity of the mechanism components, and the external environmental forces and moments are analyzed and the robot statics balance equation is established. Secondly, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the nonlinear equations. Finally, the homogeneous transformation matrix is used to solve the robot deformation contour based on the bending angle of the unit segment.

articleTitle: The Study of Entire Aircraft Level Direct Maintenance Cost Analysis Method for Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Maintenance cost is a crucial index of civil aircraft, and the direct maintenance cost is one of the vital constituents in civil aircraft maintenance cost which can be controlled by the improvement of development level. The estimation of entire aircraft direct maintenance cost is an important input to the design of civil aircraft. This paper presents the work carried out in confirming the applicable phase, optimizing the calculation factors, and performing sensitivity analysis with the study of NASA-95 method.

articleTitle: Research On Vibration Reduction Of Regular Hexahedral Honeycomb Structure With Periodic Strut
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The honeycomb cavity periodic strut structure with 3D printing technology can achieve the purpose of lightweight and vibration reduction on the basis of ensuring the stiffness and strength of the bar. In this paper, the stiffness characteristics and antivibration (resonance / flutter) ability of solid strut and regular hexahedral honeycomb periodic strut are studied by finite element analysis. The results show that the maximum deformation and maximum stress of honeycomb periodic strut are greater than that of solid strut. The maximum deformation of two kinds of rods occurs at the top of the rod, and the maximum stress of solid strut occurs at the root of the rod. The maximum stress of the honeycomb periodic strut occurs at the root of the internal honeycomb structure near the fixed end. The first six frequencies of the regular hexahedral honeycomb periodic strut are lower than those of the solid strut. The first five and seventh modes of the regular hexahedral honeycomb periodic strut are the same. The sixth, eighth, ninth and tenth modes of deformation are different.

articleTitle: Emergency Constellation Design Based on Micro SAR Satellites
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: According to the requirements of all-weather emergency remote sensing applications such as disaster prevention and earthquake rescue, high-revisit constellation design and performance simulation based on micro SAR are carried out. A microsate1Ute SAR constellation consisting of 7 orbiting planes and 35 orbiting satellites is constructed. The constellation can be revisited within 2 hours in any region of the -world to meet the needs of all-weather remote sensing applications such as disaster prevention and emergency rescue. The constellation design method provides a solution for the future low-cost, integrated, intelligent and networked micro satellite constellation system.

articleTitle: Reliability Model of Single Intemal and Extemal Meshing Planetary Gear Transmission Mechanism Considering Load Correlation
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The reliability model for single internal and external meshing planetary gear transmission mechanism considering load correlation is studied in this paper. Then, the reliability of single internal and external meshing three planetary gear transmission mechanisms is calculated using this method. Finally, in order to verify the engineering applicability and rationality, this method is compared with the Monte Carlo simulation method. The results show the rationality, advantage and applicability of this new method. Meanwhile, the reliability model considering correlation provides a general method for single internal and external meshing planetary gear transmission mechanism.

articleTitle: A Fusion Method to Estimate the State-of-Health of Lithium-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Accurate state-of-health (SOH) estimation for Lithiumion batteries (LIBs) is vital for the battery management systems (BMS). This paper puts forward a fusion method to estimate battery SOH, which incorporates the incremental capacity analysis (ICA) with the long short-term memory (LSTM) network. First, a revised Lorentzian function-based voltage-capacity (VC) model is adopted to capture the IC curve. By leveraging merely data logged during the constant current (CC) charging stage, battery degradation information contained in the IC curve is concretized as the parameters of the VC model by simple curve fitting. These parameters with specific physical meanings are deemed as features that characterize battery health status. Correlation analysis is then performed for these features, and features of interest (FOIs) are selected as inputs of the LSTM. The LSTM model can learn the long-term dependencies of battery degradation, and thus improve the robustness of the prediction model against noise. Finally, four battery aging datasets with different chemistries are employed for model validation, and results reveal that the proposed method can achieve accurate SOH estimation results, with the maximum mean absolute errors limited within 2%.

articleTitle: A New Deep Sparse Filtering Method Applied to Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Solving domain adaptation problem has always been the primary goal in transfer learning tasks. However, it is still a difficult problem to accurately diagnose fault characteristics at variable speeds. Deep sparse filtering (DSF) as an unsupervised learning algorithm, which is cleverly used for fault diagnosis. However, its diagnostic effect in the migration task is not ideal. Therefore, we propose a new Deep Sparse Filtering using Classifier Discrepancy (DSF-CD) to solve transfer learning tasks. Firstly, the characteristics of the fault signal are extracted by DSF, then two independent classifiers are used for classification diagnosis and weight adjustment. The fault diagnosis performance of the DSF-CD model is verified by the collected bearing dataset.

articleTitle: Compound fault recognition based on wavelet packet transform and the transferable combination of ResNet50 and multi-label classifier
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The rolling bearing is the important part in a motor. Traditional studies in fault diagnosis domain mainly focus on the multi-class classification. However, due to the various and complex situation in engineering application, one signal generally contains several fault feature information. Now ResNet50 is a popular basic network and generally provides a good performance. Based on wavelet packet transform, this paper proposes a transferable combination of ResNet50 and multi-label classifier (WPT-MLRN). In detail, this paper selects the wavelet packet transform as the data processing technology. Furthermore, to demonstrate that the proposed method could extract useful fault feature, the extracted features of proposed method are input into the multi-class model. In the experiment, we compare the proposed method with traditional multi-label model. And the results show that the proposed method has higher accuracy. Meanwhile, here gives the better performance when inputting the extracted feature of proposed method into the multi-class model.

articleTitle: Optimal Pricing Strategy for a Flexible Extended Warranty Policy
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Extended Warranty (EW) can only be purchased at the time of product sale or at the end of basic warranty in many practical situations. This paper proposes a flexible EW policy that allows customers to determine the start time and duration of EW coverage. The objective is to derive the optimal EW price for any arbitrarily selected coverage by maximizing the manufacturer’s profit. A variety of uncertainties such as start time, duration, unbalanced knowledge about product reliability, the risk attitude of customers, and the loyalty to the manufacturer are considered to develop the manufacturer’s profit model. The optimal EW price is proved to be proportional to the expected failure times over the EW period and the proportional coefficient is independent of the EW start time and duration. A practical example is developed to illustrate the applicability of the proposed model and sensitivity analysis is conducted to investigate the effects of various parameters on the coefficient.

articleTitle: A New ACFM Probe for Inspection of Rail Crack at High Speed
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The detection of rail crack is of great significance to ensure the safety of railway transportation. To improve the efficiency of railway operation, it is necessary to realize the high-speed detection. Based on the alternating current field measurement (ACFM) technology, this paper propose a C-shaped probe which is specially suitable for railway inspection. Using the finite element method, compared with the traditionnal U-shaped probe used in ACFM, it is verified that the C-shaped probe proposed induces a larger uniform current area on the rail, and the crack assessment is more accurate. An ACFM inspection system based on a C-shaped probe is established, and the high-speed railway turntable sample is inspected at a speed of 20km/h120km/h. The experimental results show that the established system can stably detect all surface cracks. It has the same detection ability and sensitivity at different speeds, and has good identification ability for different depth cracks.

articleTitle: System Program Design for Micro Generator Set: Gasoline Engine — PMSG — Thyristor Rectifier With Low Cost and High Reliability
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The integrated power system is a kind of important meaning power structure in many situations because of its highly efficient and power density. While the system is concluded by prime mover, battery, generator motor, rectifier and inverter, the cost and the reliability are the key matter. Especially, for the micro generator set, the matter is more serious. Firstly, the prime mover of micro generator system is hard to chose and match the generator motor. Secondly, the winding of generator motor is hard to design for satisfying kinds of power requires. Thirdly, the reliable power convertor should be small and efficient. This paper discusses the system program design for micro generator set: Gasoline Engine – three phase permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) – thyristor rectifier with low cost and high reliability. It mainly focusses on the program of prime mover, motor winding and rectifier. Consider the structure, this paper also analyzes the match between the three parts and simulate the effects. Last, this paper simulates the designed generator system program and test the effect and feasibility.

articleTitle: A Maintenance Analysis Method Associated Functional Structure for Complex Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This study proposes a maintenance analysis method associated functional structure for complex equipment from aspects of analyzing system maintenance items, conducting functional structure association feature model on qualitative design and quantitative requirements of maintainability, and conducting association analysis among maintenance qualitative factors, quantitative factors and system functional structure features. In order to illustrate the reasonability and engineering applicability, the action systems of special vehicle is taking as an example to conduct maintenance analysis associated functional structure. Finally, the analysis results show that the maintenance qualitative and quantitative design requirements are closely combined with the functional structural features, so that the forward design of maintainability can be operated in skinny system. AU in all, this study not only provides a new research idea for maintenance analysis, but also can be as a typical example to guide the similar problems.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamic Characteristics of Double Span Rotor-Bearing System with Slowly-varying Excitation Frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In this paper, the rotor-bearing system with slow variation of excitation frequency is studied by numerical simulation and experimental research. In the aspect of numerical simulation, based on the finite element method, a dynamic model with the slow variation of excitation frequency is established, numerical calculations are performed using the Newmark- $\beta$ method, which is used to simulate the effect of slow change of excitation frequency on rotor-bearing by adjusting the parameters. The results show that the motion of the rotor system with slowly varying excitation frequency is chaotic motion, and the system motion is mainly divided frequency motion at a high rotational speed. The variation of speed, amplitude coefficient and time parameter will affect the main motion components of the system, the amplitude of each frequency and the stability of the rotor system. Meanwhile, the correctness of the theoretical results is verified by experimental analysis. These characteristics can provide some theoretical and practical basis for the future research of the rotor system with slow variable parameters.

articleTitle: A Post-Warranty Maintenance Strategy Considering Product Age
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: When a non-renewing warranty period expires, the customer can know the age of the product surviving warranty period. In this paper, by making use of the surviving product’s age information, an improved post-warranty maintenance strategy is proposed. Based on renewal process theory, the product life cycle cost rate is derived explicitly. Numerical results show that the proposed post-warranty maintenance strategy can achieve a lower cost rate than the one without considering the surviving product’s age information.

articleTitle: An Information Transmission Model For Offshore Wind Turbines Based On Multi-variable Coupling Relationship
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The monitoring variables of offshore wind turbines are widely distributed and coupled with each other, and the relationship of information transfer is fuzzy, which brings great challenges to the research of performance characterization and fault diagnosis of wind turbines. Therefore, an information transmission model for offshore wind turbines was proposes based on multi-variable coupling relationships. First, based on the DBSCAN unsupervised clustering method, the different states corresponding to the performance of the wind turbine are obtained. Second, the general symbolic parameters of the monitoring time series are determined, and the adaptive symbolic processing of the monitoring time series is performed. Finally, the transfer entropy of symbolic sequence pair is calculated and the information transmission model is established. By analyzing the change of information transmission between nodes, the performance is characterized, which provides a good model basis for fault traceability.

articleTitle: Study on Static and Dynamic Characteristics of Tilting Pad Thrust Bearings with Journal Inclination
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper presents an analytical investigation of the oil film static and dynamic characteristics on journal inclination tilting pad thrust bearings. A three degree-of-freedom mathematic model for is used to calculate lubricated characteristics of oil film. Then, a systematical study to investigate the effect of journal inclination and elastic deformation on the static and dynamic characteristics for thrust bearing is presented. The study on the resistance of pressure and temperature with journal inclination bearing has great significance to ensure the stability and safety of thrust bearing.

articleTitle: A Low Noise Amplifier of Wireless Receiver for Internet of Things Towards a Smart City
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is the third technological revolution in the information technology industry. The application of IoT products will help construct smart cities. Communication chips are the basis for the realization of the IoT. This article focuses on the design of a low noise amplifier (LNA) for the IoT in smart cities. The LNA combines a resistance feedback common source structure and noise cancellation technology to obtain input matching and low noise figure. The proposed LNA is fabricated in 0.18$\mu$m CMOS process, which can drive an external 50$\Omega$ load and achieve minimum NF of 2dB at 200M$\sim $930MHz and input return loss (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>) better than -15dB, the achieved gain (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>) and IPldB is 18.2 dB and -18.7dBm.

articleTitle: Prediction method of high-rise building foundation settlement based on GPS Baseline Solution
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The traditional foundation settlement prediction method of high-rise buildings cannot achieve average distribution in the distribution of unit weight ratio, resulting in poor accuracy of foundation settlement prediction calculation. In order to improve the prediction accuracy, a foundation settlement prediction method of high-rise buildings based on GPS baseline solution is proposed. The expression of three-phase system composed of soil particles, pore water and pore gas is constructed, and the variation trend of density pressure between foundation surface water and soil is analyzed; Based on the GPS baseline solution, the unit weight ratio is allocated to improve the detection accuracy of cycle slip, accurately calculate the ionospheric residuals before and after epochs, reset the proportion and redistribute the weight of a posteriori variance component estimation; The Poisson curve expression is established to calculate the main consolidation settlement of high-rise buildings, and the foundation settlement prediction model is established. A comparative experiment is designed to test the accuracy of the three prediction methods. In the prediction test of untreated foundation settlement and the prediction test of foundation settlement after filling treatment, the algorithm is better than the other two algorithms. It can be seen that the prediction result of GPS baseline solution algorithm is more accurate.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method of Rolling Bearing Based on CEEMDAN and KFCM
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Considering that the signals generated by faulty rolling bearings are often nonstationary and nonlinear. In this paper, a hybrid method based on Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) and Kernel Fuzzy C-Means (KFCM) algorithm for rolling bearing fault diagnosis is proposed. First, the signal is decomposed to obtain intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) based on CEEMDAN method. Second, feature vector matrices of rolling bearings are established through the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) of IMFs. Finally, we utilize KFCM algorithm and Hamming nearness degree to diagnose the type of faults. The experimental result proves that the proposed fault diagnosis approach is of high performance.

articleTitle: An optimized multivariate variational mode decomposition for the fault diagnosis of rotating machinery
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Various failures are prone to occur in rotating machinery due to the harsh working conditions, thereby making it a vital work to perform accurate fault diagnosis to prevent performance degradation and safety hazards. The presence of multivariate variational mode decomposition (MVMD) provides a good knowledge of how to cope with multichannel data which contains more comprehensive information. In this work, an innovative diagnostic approach based on optimized MVMD is proposed for rotating machinery. Corner-stone of this method is the optimized MVMD, a new approach extracting modes successively with the proper adjustment of initial center frequencies. It achieves the mode decomposition without prior knowledge of the number of modes and initial center frequencies which affect the decomposition results greatly. Moreover, normalized frequency-to-energy ratio is employed as an index for selection of faulty modes. Analysis and comparison results of the experiment data from defective bearing indicates that the new approach shows a prominent superiority in fault identification.

articleTitle: Full-Parameters Identification Technique of Attenuated Oscillations in Power System Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: It is vital to accurately identify the modal parameters of oscillation signals to control and even avoid low-frequency oscillations which threaten the stability of power system. A novel full-parameters identification technique is developed in this paper to identify all modal parameters of attenuated low-frequency oscillations based on stochastic subspace identification (SSI) and Prony algorithms by the parameter matching approach. Firstly, empirical mode decomposition (EMD) is applied to filter and smooth the oscillation signal. Then, SSI and Prony are used to identify the modal parameters by parameter matching. Through a case study with the proposed method, we find the reconstructed signal based on the modal parameters acquired are largely consistent with the original signal, by removing interference, identifying modal parameters and overcoming the weakness of single algorithm. Therefore, the proposed method can accurately identify full modal parameters of attenuated low-frequency oscillations and enhance the stability and safety of power system by monitoring and controlling oscillations.

articleTitle: Tool Wear State Monitoring Based on Diagonal Slice Spectrum Amplitude Feature
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Tool wear is one of the most common tool failure modes. And the vibration signals of tool wear show strong nonlinear and non-Gaussian characteristics. Bispectrum is an effective method to analyze nonlinear and non-Gaussian signals. However, bispectrum is not only difficult to understand, but also computationally intensive. This paper presents a milling tool condition monitoring method based on the amplitude feature of tool characteristic frequency of bispectral diagonal slices. Bispectral diagonal slice is used as tool wear signal processing method to identify tool states. And the amplitude feature of tool characteristic frequency of bispectral diagonal slices was selected to monitor tool wear. The effectiveness of the proposed method has been verified by the experiment. Results showed that the proposed approach is able to effectively extract the feature information of tool wear state, and reduces the calculation cost.

articleTitle: Elevator Performance Evaluation Based on the Analysis of the Running Sound
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The sound signal during the operation of an elevator is related to the performance of which, so the current performance of an elevator can be obtained through the analysis of the sound signal. This paper proposes a performance evaluation method by the analysis of the sound signal for an elevator. The sound acquisition method for elevators is designed, and the sound signals of normal elevators and abnormal ones are collected separately. According to the operation of the door and the car, the sound signals are processed respectively to extract the features. Combined with the Grey Relational Analysis and Fuzzy Comprehensive Appraisal, a performance evaluation method based on the features of the elevator sound is constructed for elevators. Finally, the experimental verification is carried out. The results show that the evaluation error of the method is small compared with the actual situation, so the method can be used to evaluate the performance of elevators.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of reciprocating compressor with revolution joint clearance and translational joint clearance
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: the dynamic analysis of reciprocating compressor with revolution joint clearance and translational joint clearance is introduced. The effect of the revolution joint clearance is expressed by the massless rod, and the interaction force between crosshead and the guide is expressed by the elastic damping collision force. The reciprocating compressor model with two kinds of wear clearance faults is established. Through numerical simulation, the variation law of crosshead motion parameters is found. The numerical results show that when there is a revolution joint clearance, translational joint clearance increases continuously, its displacement fluctuation is very small, its acceleration changes the most, and its velocity changes are affected in a certain time period. In the presence of crosshead wear clearance, the wear revolution joint clearance increases continuously. Similarly, its displacement fluctuation is very small, its acceleration changes the most, and its velocity changes are affected in a certain time period. The stability of the system with two kinds of wear clearance faults is judged by phase diagram method and maximum Lyapunov exponent method. It is found that the system is chaotic.

articleTitle: Transmission System Bearing Fault Detection Method Based on Modulated Signal Bi-spectrum Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Rolling element bearing are key mechanical parts in rotating machinery and large equipment such as helicopters, wind turbines and ships. Running under severe working environments and suffering extreme load and speed conditions, bearings may be damaged. Bearing fault will degrades the overall performance of the transmission system, thus monitoring and fault detection of bearing is necessary for industry. However, bearing monitoring signal is usually influenced by noises, and traditional spectrum and time-frequency analysis cannot reflect the phase information within the signal. To address this problem, a fault detection method based on modulated signal bi-spectrum is proposed in this paper after reexamining characteristic of bearing monitoring signal, the method is validated using experiment signals. The result indicates that the method proposed in this paper is effective to detect bearing fault in transmission drive train.

articleTitle: Laser scanning-based method for identifying damage location of civil construction node structure
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The traditional structural damage location identification method has the problem of large error in damage location ranging and damage area calibration. Therefore, this paper proposes a damage location identification method for civil building node structure based on laser scanning. According to the civil construction node structure, choose the right means of single line scan, calibrated laser scanner to scan parameters, construction node structure point cloud data, build the nonuniform grid, streamlining the point cloud data, filter for removing noise point cloud, the extraction and matching feature point cloud data, building structure model, determine the node structure damage location coordinates. Experimental results show that the design method reduces the damage location error and damage area calibration error, and improves the damage location identification accuracy.

articleTitle: Robust Vibration Signal Denoising and Diagnosis Using Encoder-Decoder Networks with Cross-layer Residual Connection
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In the process of signal collection, the existence of noise is inevitable. However, noise brings great difficulties to subsequent signal analysis, fault diagnosis and life prediction. To solve the above problems, we propose an encoder-decoder network with cross-layer residual connection for signal denoising (CLR-CNN). In this network, the cross-layer residual connection can make CLRCNN predict noise and remove noise better. Non-local-block (NLB) is used to capture remote signal information. Leaky-ReLU can retain the negative information of the signal. CLR-CNN is trained by using the noisy bearing dataset, and effective signal is obtained by subtracting the noise from the original signal. Compared with traditional denoising methods and a deep learning method (NLFCNN), it has better denoising performance. In addition, CLRCNN can significantly improve the performance of fault diagnosis at the noise level.

articleTitle: An adaptive prediction method of remaining useful lifetime for the aviation product based on the proportional degradation model
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The traditional prediction methods of the remaining useful lifetime (RUL) for the product require a large amount of historical data as support. But for the expensive aviation product, the degradation experiments with large sample sizes are unacceptable. Aiming at this problem, an adaptive RUL prediction method for the single aviation product based on the proportional degradation model is proposed. Firstly, a nonlinear Wiener degradation model with a proportional process is built. Then, based on the small sample or single sample degradation data, the degradation state update method based on the EM-KF is proposed. Finally, using the aviation product performance degradation data to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Multilayer Domain Adaptation-Based Convolutional Auto Encoder for Fault Diagnosis under Different Speeds
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Application of deep learning in fault diagnosis have developed rapidly in recent years. The majority of fault diagnosis methods can achieve satisfactory results only on the basis of the assumptions that training and testing data come from the same data distribution and sufficient labeled data are necessary for model training. However, These assumptions do not always hold in actual situations. In light of this problem, a transfer learning-based method named multilayer domain adaptation-based convolutional auto encoder (MDACAE) is proposed in this paper. The Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) and Wasserstein Distance (WD) are both applied in the last three layers of the proposed model. Finally, a dataset collected from rolling bearings is used to demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method. Results reveal that the proposed MDACAE can obtain better results of domain adaptation and have superior diagnostic capability.

articleTitle: A two-stage approach for modeling inverse S-shaped wear processes of cutting tools
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Wear is one of major failure causes of cutting tools. Monitoring the wear process of a cutting tool and predicting its residual life have attracted wide attentions. A stochastic wear process model that relates the wear amount to cumulative cutting time is needed so as to make the inspection and replacement decisions of the cutting tool. The wear amount as a function of cutting time is often inverse S-shaped. That is, the wear rate curve is bathtub-shaped. The works that explicitly model inverse S-shaped wear processes are rare. This paper presents a two-stage approach for modeling this type of wear processes. The proposed approach divides the process into two stages with the inflection point of the wear curve as the boundary of stages. The task in the first stage is to collect data and the tasks in the second stage are to predict residual life and make inspection and replacement decisions. The stochastic wear process model obtained from the proposed approach is simple and realistic, and does not need many data. A real-world example is included to illustrate the simplicity and appropriateness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Condition-based opportunistic Maintenance Strategy for Mechanical System
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In this paper, a new condition-based opportunistic maintenance strategy is proposed for the mechanical components in multi-component system which meet the characteristics of continuous increasing deterioration. This strategy uses the Gamma process to describe the performance degradation trend of mechanical components. Based on the existing single-component maintenance strategy, the detection intersectionality is introduced to describe the maintenance correlation between components, and group the components multiple times. Besides, the system-level condition-based opportunistic maintenance model is established with the goal of minimizing the average maintenance cost rate. Finally, the model is applied to the key components of a certain type of elevators, and the simulation results show that the model can significantly reduce the maintenance cost rate of the elevators compared with the optimization of the single-component maintenance strategy alone.

articleTitle: Research on Extraction Method of Sensitive Feature of Thin-wall Plate Crack Fault
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In this paper, the research on vibration simulation and signal analysis technology of thin-wall plate crack fault is mainly carried out. First, the 3D structure of the thin-wall plate is established, and a semi-elliptical crack in the root of the thin-wall plate is introduced. Based on the vibration simulation response of cracked thin-wall plates under variable working conditions, the vibration signals of normal thin-wall plates are compared and analyzed, and the sensitive feature of cracked thin-wall plates is extracted by wavelet packet analysis. The thin-wall plate test pieces required for producing fatigue cracks are prepared, and tested on the shaking test rig. Finally, the simulation technology of the cracked thin-wall plates under variable working conditions, the signal analysis methods and the sensitive feature of the cracks are verified.

articleTitle: Sequential Fault Diagnosis with Double Layer Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In this paper, the sequential fault diagnosis problem considering double layer uncertainty is studied. Test uncertainty is divided into inherent uncertainty and observation uncertainty, where the latter may vary from one tester to another. How to carry out diagnosis inference given the uncertain test result and the strategy to select the best test at each step are formulated in detail. Simulation and comparison are carried out to test the proposed method. The result shows that the method presented in this paper can reduce the false isolation rate compared to the previous one. It is more flexible and has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: A Single-pressing Point Solar Array Restraint and Release System Based on Thermal Knife
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper describes a single-pressing point Solar Array Restraint and Release System (SARRS) based on thermal knife. Compared with the pyrotechnics SARRS, thermal knife is small impact, no pollution, convenient transport; Compared to the multi-pressing point thermal knife SARRS, a single-pressing point SARRS is simple, high reliability, more suitable for aerospace products, especially suitable for small satellite SARRS. This paper first introduces the composition and working principle of SARRS based on thermal knife and its key components. Secondly, the ground test is carried out on the modal of its emission state and in- orbit state. Finally, the relevant tests were carried out on the release of room temperature and the low temperature.

Author Keywords: Solar Array Restraint and Release System (SARRS)

articleTitle: A Bivariate Degradation Model Based on Gamma Processes with Dependent Scale Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: Lots of products have more than one performance characteristic (PC), which makes it difficult to model their degradation processes and assess their reliabilities. In this paper, a bivariate degradation model is proposed based on nonlinear gamma processes, and the scale parameters are regarded as random variables that share a common item. A parameter estimation method based on maximum likelihood is proposed, and the reliability function of the product can be calculated after an analytical integral. The simulation study shows the good validities of the parameter estimation method and the reliability function. In the end, a case study based on a group of fatigue crack development data is presented, which demonstrates the application of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Intelligent Document Processing Method Based on Robot Process Automation
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: This paper discusses the importance of document format information in document understanding and the latest research progress in the field of document content understanding, document classification, document format checking and error correction, document interoperability and document intelligent processing, and proposes a method of document intelligent processing based on robotic process automation. The relationship between document understanding and intelligent processing of information in different document formats and layouts is briefly explained.

articleTitle: Online Collecting Method of Real-time Situation Information of NEV Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low efficiency of online acquisition based on smoothed window and integral graph, a real-time online acquisition method for NEV operation situation information is proposed. Using machine vision technology to identify the road and obstacles, eliminate interference information, determine the road nearest point. According to the principle of acquisition based on machine vision, the instruction of the internal acquisition module is given. Through remote online calibration, data acquisition sequence is controlled, remote program is upgraded, and the information can reach the instruction position quickly. A feedback loop is designed to control acquisition error by error feedback coefficient. The expérimentai resufts show that the maximum acquisition efficiency of this method is 80%, which has good acquisition effect.

articleTitle: Diagnosis Methodology of Joint Faults in Single-Stage Actuation Ring-Vanes System Based on FRF Characterization
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The variable stator vanes (VSV) is prone to happen joint faults such as wear and stagnation due to complex structure and a large number of kinematic pairs. Based on the circumferential spatial distribution characteristics of the joints around actuation ring, this paper establishes a single-stage ring torsional inertia-spring model that considers nonlinearity caused by joint faults. Refer to a real aero-engine’s VSV structure, the system parameters of the model are obtained by simplifying, and then the motion differential equation of the system is obtained. The torsional vibration response of each vane of the system is obtained by the newmark$-\beta$ integral method. This paper also developed a diagnosis methodology based on the nonlinear output frequency response functions (NOFRFs), and established a second-order optimal weighted contribution rate indices Rm. Based on the torsional vibration response of each vane, the corresponding Rm is extracted. The asymmetry characteristic of the Rm around the single-stage actuation ring with fault to the excitation vane is established, and the influence of the excitation intensity and other factors on the asymmetry are analyzed. The results show that the diagnosis methodology proposed in this paper can effectively detect joint faults of VSV in aero-engine.

articleTitle: Outlier mining method for high dimensional massive data based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The density of high-dimensional massive data is relatively high, and it is difficult to mine outlier information. The traditional mining method is too slow to mine outliers in highdimensional massive data because the divided mining density is too balanced. Therefore, the research on the high-dimensional massive data outlier mining method based on RBF neural network is studied. In this method, RBF neural network structure and hidden layer parameters are set, and the mining density of highdimensional massive data is set to realize the outlier mining of high-dimensional massive data. The experimental results show that: compared with the traditional mining methods, the outlier mining method in this study can first complete the task of outlier mining in high-dimensional massive data. It can be seen that the mining method of this study improves the speed of data mining.

articleTitle: A Novel Model of Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on Convolutional Auto-encoder and Capsule Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: A convolutional auto-encoder and capsule network based fault identification method (CaCAE) for rotating machinery is proposed. Firstly, the convolutional auto-encoder is constructed, to quickly and simply extract shallow-level features from the raw fault data without a priori knowledge. Then, the improved capsule network accepts the feature information extracted by the convolutional auto-encoder, and extracts higher-level feature capsules to represent the health status by a dynamic routing algorithm. The feature capsules can enhance the information mining capability of the model and improve the classification accuracy. Finally, the lengths of the capsules are used to classify the fault category. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, an example with 100% classification accuracy and 38s running time was obtained on a rolling bearing test bench. In addition, the performances of artificial neural network, classical convolutional neural network and the original capsule network are evaluated for contrast with the proposed method. In conclusion, the CaCAE obtains higher classification accuracy and faster convergence speed.

articleTitle: A Novel Strategy for Signal Denoising Using Two-Layer SVD and its Application to Rub-impact Fault Diagnosis of Aero-engine
publicationTitle: 2021 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Nanjing)
abstract: The rub-impact fault, which occur in the aero-engine, can cause the frequency modulation (FM) in its vibration signal. Oscillated instantaneous frequency (IF) is a phenomenon of such kind of modulation mode, which carry critical fault information of aero-engine. In this paper, by using bandpass filter, which allow IX and 3X to pass respectively, vibration signal can be divided into two signal components. Two-layer Singular value decomposition (SVD) is utilized to reduce signal noise of each signal component and instantaneous frequency of each signal component. The intrawave FM feature of the signal are presented through the HT analysis. The proposed method is validated with numerical simulation and then demonstrated on aero-engine data with rub-impact fault. The proposed method is proper for the analysis of modulated signals and is a valid tool for detecting rub-impact faults of aero-engine.
